import Mathlib

/-!
Woodruff, "Sketching as a Tool for Numerical Linear Algebra" (arXiv 1411.4357), §4.2.1,
Corollary 54. Definitions and statement copied verbatim from `cor54/Statement.lean`; the proof is
our own. It combines our kernel-checked Theorem 9 (`proofs/Modular.lean`, included verbatim) and
Theorem 50 (`bss/proofs/BSS.lean`, included verbatim): Theorem 9 at δ = 1/100 makes the sketch a
(1 ± ε) embedding of every aᵢ with probability 0.99; Theorem 50 on the sketched vectors gives the
weights; the per-vector embedding turns Σ sᵢ‖Waᵢ‖² ≤ Σ‖Waᵢ‖² into the (1+ε)/(1−ε) bound.
-/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

/-- The sketch of a vector: bucket `j` collects `σ i * v i` over the coordinates `i` hashed to `j`. -/
def sketch {n r : ℕ} (h : Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Fin n → ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin r → ℝ :=
  fun j => ∑ i, if h i = j then σ i * v i else 0

/-- L1: a quadratic form is bounded by the Frobenius norm times the squared norm. -/
theorem L1 {k : ℕ} (M : Fin k → Fin k → ℝ) (z : Fin k → ℝ) :
    |∑ a, ∑ b, M a b * z a * z b| ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ a, ∑ b, M a b ^ 2) * ∑ a, z a ^ 2 := by
  have hB : ∑ a, ∑ b, (z a * z b) ^ 2 = (∑ a, z a ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq (∑ a, z a ^ 2), Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    ring
  have hS : ∑ a, ∑ b, M a b * z a * z b = ∑ a, ∑ b, M a b * (z a * z b) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    ring
  have key : (∑ a, ∑ b, M a b * z a * z b) ^ 2
      ≤ (∑ a, ∑ b, M a b ^ 2) * (∑ a, z a ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    have h := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k × Fin k))
      (fun p => M p.1 p.2) (fun p => z p.1 * z p.2)
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type] at h
    rw [hS, ← hB]
    exact h
  have hz : 0 ≤ ∑ a, z a ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => sq_nonneg _
  calc |∑ a, ∑ b, M a b * z a * z b|
      = Real.sqrt ((∑ a, ∑ b, M a b * z a * z b) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs _).symm
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((∑ a, ∑ b, M a b ^ 2) * (∑ a, z a ^ 2) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt key
    _ = Real.sqrt (∑ a, ∑ b, M a b ^ 2) * ∑ a, z a ^ 2 := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul' _ (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hz]

/-- L2: with signs ±1, the sketch's squared norm is the vector's plus the colliding cross terms. -/
theorem L2 {n r : ℕ} (h : Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Fin n → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ i, σ i = 1 ∨ σ i = -1) (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ j, (sketch h σ v j) ^ 2 =
      ∑ i, v i ^ 2 + ∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then σ i * σ j * v i * v j else 0 := by
  have key : ∀ i i', (∑ j, (if h i = j then σ i * v i else 0) * (if h i' = j then σ i' * v i' else 0))
      = if h i = h i' then σ i * v i * (σ i' * v i') else 0 := by
    intro i i'
    simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    by_cases hh : h i = h i'
    · simp [hh]
    · simp [hh, Ne.symm hh]
  have split : ∀ i i', (if h i = h i' then σ i * v i * (σ i' * v i') else 0)
      = (if i = i' then v i ^ 2 else 0)
        + (if i ≠ i' ∧ h i = h i' then σ i * σ i' * v i * v i' else 0) := by
    intro i i'
    by_cases hii : i = i'
    · subst hii
      have hs : σ i * σ i = 1 := by
        rcases hσ i with h1 | h1 <;> rw [h1] <;> norm_num
      simp only [if_true, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_and, if_false, add_zero]
      linear_combination (v i ^ 2) * hs
    · by_cases hh : h i = h i'
      · simp only [hh, hii, if_true, if_false, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, and_self, zero_add]
        ring
      · simp [hii, hh]
  calc
    ∑ j, (sketch h σ v j) ^ 2
        = ∑ i, ∑ i', ∑ j, (if h i = j then σ i * v i else 0) * (if h i' = j then σ i' * v i' else 0) := by
      unfold sketch
      simp only [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ i', (if i = i' then v i ^ 2 else 0)
          + ∑ i, ∑ i', (if i ≠ i' ∧ h i = h i' then σ i * σ i' * v i * v i' else 0) := by
      simp only [key, split, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = _ := by
      simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq]

lemma L3_swap22 {α β γ δ : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] [Fintype δ]
    (f : α → β → γ → δ → ℝ) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ d, f a b c d = ∑ c, ∑ d, ∑ a, ∑ b, f a b c d := by
  calc ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ d, f a b c d = ∑ a, ∑ c, ∑ b, ∑ d, f a b c d :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ a, ∑ c, ∑ d, ∑ b, f a b c d :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ c, ∑ a, ∑ d, ∑ b, f a b c d := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ c, ∑ d, ∑ a, ∑ b, f a b c d := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => Finset.sum_comm

lemma L3_expand_gen {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (F : ι → ι → κ → κ → ℝ) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, ∑ j, F i j a b) ^ 2
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ i', ∑ j', ∑ a, ∑ b, F i j a b * F i' j' a b := by
  calc ∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, ∑ j, F i j a b) ^ 2
        = ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ i', ∑ j', F i j a b * F i' j' a b := by
          simp_rw [sq, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ i', ∑ j', F i j a b * F i' j' a b := L3_swap22 _
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => L3_swap22 _

lemma L3_expand {n k r : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (x : Fin n → Fin r) (s : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ x i = x j then s i * s j * U i a * U j b else 0) ^ 2
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ i', ∑ j',
          ((if i ≠ j ∧ x i = x j then (1:ℝ) else 0) * (if i' ≠ j' ∧ x i' = x j' then (1:ℝ) else 0))
            * (s i * s j * s i' * s j') * (∑ a, ∑ b, U i a * U j b * U i' a * U j' b) := by
  rw [L3_expand_gen (fun i j a b => if i ≠ j ∧ x i = x j then s i * s j * U i a * U j b else 0)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j' _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  beta_reduce
  split_ifs <;> ring

lemma L3_int_congr {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) {f g : Ω → ℝ}
    (hfg : ∀ ω, f ω = g ω) : ∫ ω, f ω ∂μ = ∫ ω, g ω ∂μ :=
  congrArg (integral μ) (funext hfg)

lemma L3_integral_sum4 {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (F : ι → ι → ι → ι → Ω → ℝ) (hF : ∀ i j k l, Integrable (F i j k l) μ) :
    ∫ ω, ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ l, F i j k l ω ∂μ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ l, ∫ ω, F i j k l ω ∂μ := by
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun l _ => hF i j k l]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun j _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun k _ =>
    integrable_finsetSum _ fun l _ => hF i j k l]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun k _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun l _ => hF i j k l]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun l _ => hF i j k l]

lemma L3_pick {n : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (v : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    ∑ i', ∑ j', (if i' = i ∧ j' = j then c else 0) * v i' j' = c * v i j := by
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single i (fun i' hi' => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j' _ => by
      rw [if_neg (fun hh => hi' hh.1), zero_mul]),
    Fintype.sum_eq_single j (fun j' hj' => by rw [if_neg (fun hh => hj' hh.2), zero_mul]),
    if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩]

lemma L3_sign_two {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) {n : ℕ} (σ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ)
    (σfour : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n), T.card ≤ 4 → T.Nonempty → ∫ ω, ∏ i ∈ T, σ ω i ∂μ = 0)
    {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) : ∫ ω, σ ω a * σ ω b ∂μ = 0 := by
  have := σfour {a, b} (Finset.card_le_two.trans (by norm_num)) (by simp)
  simpa only [Finset.prod_pair hab] using this

lemma L3_sign_four {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) {n : ℕ} (σ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ)
    (σfour : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n), T.card ≤ 4 → T.Nonempty → ∫ ω, ∏ i ∈ T, σ ω i ∂μ = 0)
    {a b c d : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (had : a ≠ d) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hbd : b ≠ d)
    (hcd : c ≠ d) : ∫ ω, σ ω a * σ ω b * σ ω c * σ ω d ∂μ = 0 := by
  have := σfour {a, b, c, d} Finset.card_le_four (by simp)
  have key : ∀ ω, ∏ t ∈ ({a, b, c, d} : Finset (Fin n)), σ ω t
      = σ ω a * σ ω b * σ ω c * σ ω d := by
    intro ω
    rw [Finset.prod_insert (by simp [hab, hac, had]), Finset.prod_insert (by simp [hbc, hbd]),
      Finset.prod_pair hcd]
    ring
  simpa only [key] using this

lemma L3_sign_moment {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n : ℕ} (σ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ)
    (σsign : ∀ ω i, σ ω i = 1 ∨ σ ω i = -1)
    (σfour : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n), T.card ≤ 4 → T.Nonempty → ∫ ω, ∏ i ∈ T, σ ω i ∂μ = 0)
    {i j i' j' : Fin n} (hij : i ≠ j) (hij' : i' ≠ j') :
    ∫ ω, σ ω i * σ ω j * σ ω i' * σ ω j' ∂μ =
      if (i' = i ∧ j' = j) ∨ (i' = j ∧ j' = i) then 1 else 0 := by
  have hsq : ∀ ω t, σ ω t * σ ω t = 1 := by
    intro ω t; rcases σsign ω t with e | e <;> rw [e] <;> norm_num
  split_ifs with hD
  · have h1 : ∀ ω, σ ω i * σ ω j * σ ω i' * σ ω j' = 1 := by
      intro ω
      rcases hD with ⟨e1, e2⟩ | ⟨e1, e2⟩ <;> rw [e1, e2] <;>
        linear_combination (σ ω j * σ ω j) * hsq ω i + hsq ω j
    simp [h1]
  · by_cases h1 : i' = i
    · subst i'
      have hjj : j ≠ j' := fun e => hD (Or.inl ⟨rfl, e.symm⟩)
      refine (L3_int_congr μ fun ω => ?_).trans (L3_sign_two μ σ σfour hjj)
      linear_combination (σ ω j * σ ω j') * hsq ω i
    by_cases h2 : i' = j
    · subst i'
      have hij2 : i ≠ j' := fun e => hD (Or.inr ⟨rfl, e.symm⟩)
      refine (L3_int_congr μ fun ω => ?_).trans (L3_sign_two μ σ σfour hij2)
      linear_combination (σ ω i * σ ω j') * hsq ω j
    by_cases h3 : j' = i
    · subst j'
      have hji : j ≠ i' := fun e => h2 e.symm
      refine (L3_int_congr μ fun ω => ?_).trans (L3_sign_two μ σ σfour hji)
      linear_combination (σ ω j * σ ω i') * hsq ω i
    by_cases h4 : j' = j
    · subst j'
      have hii : i ≠ i' := fun e => h1 e.symm
      refine (L3_int_congr μ fun ω => ?_).trans (L3_sign_two μ σ σfour hii)
      linear_combination (σ ω i * σ ω i') * hsq ω j
    exact L3_sign_four μ σ σfour hij (fun e => h1 e.symm) (fun e => h3 e.symm)
      (fun e => h2 e.symm) (fun e => h4 e.symm) hij'

/-- L3: the second moment of the cross-term matrix, under pairwise-independent `h`,
4-wise-independent ±1 signs `σ`, and `h` independent of `σ`. -/
theorem L3 {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n k r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (h : Ω → Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hmeas : Measurable h) (σmeas : Measurable σ)
    (hpair : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → ∀ a b : Fin r,
      μ {ω | h ω i = a ∧ h ω j = b} = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (r : ℝ) ^ 2))
    (σsign : ∀ ω i, σ ω i = 1 ∨ σ ω i = -1)
    (σfour : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n), T.card ≤ 4 → T.Nonempty → ∫ ω, ∏ i ∈ T, σ ω i ∂μ = 0)
    (hσind : IndepFun h σ μ) :
    ∫ ω, ∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ h ω i = h ω j then σ ω i * σ ω j * U i a * U j b else 0) ^ 2 ∂μ
      ≤ ((∑ i, ∑ a, U i a ^ 2) ^ 2 + ∑ i, ∑ j, (∑ a, U i a * U j a) ^ 2) / r := by
  have hr' : (r:ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hr.ne'
  have hab : ∀ ω i, |σ ω i| = 1 := by
    intro ω i; rcases σsign ω i with e | e <;> simp [e]
  have hfm : ∀ i j i' j' : Fin n, Measurable (fun x : Fin n → Fin r =>
      (if i ≠ j ∧ x i = x j then (1:ℝ) else 0) * (if i' ≠ j' ∧ x i' = x j' then (1:ℝ) else 0)) :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => measurable_of_finite _
  have hgm : ∀ i j i' j' : Fin n, Measurable (fun s : Fin n → ℝ => s i * s j * s i' * s j') := by
    intro i j i' j'; fun_prop
  -- integrability of each expanded term
  have hint : ∀ i j i' j' : Fin n, Integrable (fun ω =>
      ((if i ≠ j ∧ h ω i = h ω j then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
        (if i' ≠ j' ∧ h ω i' = h ω j' then (1:ℝ) else 0)) *
        (σ ω i * σ ω j * σ ω i' * σ ω j')) μ := by
    intro i j i' j'
    refine Integrable.of_bound
      (((hfm i j i' j').comp hmeas).mul ((hgm i j i' j').comp σmeas)).aestronglyMeasurable 1
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, hab, mul_one]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hint' : ∀ i j i' j' : Fin n, Integrable (fun ω =>
      ((if i ≠ j ∧ h ω i = h ω j then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
        (if i' ≠ j' ∧ h ω i' = h ω j' then (1:ℝ) else 0)) *
        (σ ω i * σ ω j * σ ω i' * σ ω j') * (∑ a, ∑ b, U i a * U j b * U i' a * U j' b)) μ :=
    fun i j i' j' => (hint i j i' j').mul_const _
  -- collision probability
  have hcoll : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j →
      ∫ ω, (if h ω i = h ω j then (1:ℝ) else 0) ∂μ = 1 / r := by
    intro i j hij
    have hmeasA : ∀ a : Fin r, MeasurableSet {ω | h ω i = a ∧ h ω j = a} := fun a =>
      (Set.toFinite {x : Fin n → Fin r | x i = a ∧ x j = a}).measurableSet.preimage hmeas
    have hI : ∀ a : Fin r, Integrable
        (fun ω => Set.indicator {ω | h ω i = a ∧ h ω j = a} (1 : Ω → ℝ) ω) μ :=
      fun a => (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (hmeasA a)
    have hpt : ∀ ω, (if h ω i = h ω j then (1:ℝ) else 0)
        = ∑ a : Fin r, Set.indicator {ω | h ω i = a ∧ h ω j = a} (1 : Ω → ℝ) ω := by
      intro ω
      simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Pi.one_apply]
      by_cases e : h ω i = h ω j
      · rw [if_pos e, Finset.sum_eq_single (h ω i)]
        · rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, e.symm⟩]
        · intro a _ ha; rw [if_neg]; rintro ⟨h1, -⟩; exact ha h1.symm
        · intro hh; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) hh
      · rw [if_neg e]; symm; refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a _ => ?_
        rw [if_neg]; rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact e (h1.trans h2.symm)
    have hval : ∀ a : Fin r,
        ∫ ω, Set.indicator {ω | h ω i = a ∧ h ω j = a} (1 : Ω → ℝ) ω ∂μ = 1 / (r:ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      intro a
      rw [integral_indicator_one (hmeasA a), measureReal_def, hpair i j hij a a,
        ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)]
    rw [L3_int_congr μ hpt, integral_finsetSum _ (fun a _ => hI a)]
    simp only [hval, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    try ring
  -- one expectation term
  have hE : ∀ i j i' j' : Fin n, ∫ ω, ((if i ≠ j ∧ h ω i = h ω j then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
        (if i' ≠ j' ∧ h ω i' = h ω j' then (1:ℝ) else 0)) * (σ ω i * σ ω j * σ ω i' * σ ω j') ∂μ
      = if i ≠ j ∧ ((i' = i ∧ j' = j) ∨ (i' = j ∧ j' = i)) then 1 / (r:ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro i j i' j'
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; simp
    by_cases hij' : i' = j'
    · subst hij'
      rw [if_neg]
      · simp
      · rintro ⟨hne, ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
        · exact hne (h1.symm.trans h2)
        · exact hne (h2.symm.trans h1)
    have key : ∫ ω, ((if i ≠ j ∧ h ω i = h ω j then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
        (if i' ≠ j' ∧ h ω i' = h ω j' then (1:ℝ) else 0)) * (σ ω i * σ ω j * σ ω i' * σ ω j') ∂μ
        = (∫ ω, (if i ≠ j ∧ h ω i = h ω j then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
            (if i' ≠ j' ∧ h ω i' = h ω j' then (1:ℝ) else 0) ∂μ) *
          (∫ ω, σ ω i * σ ω j * σ ω i' * σ ω j' ∂μ) :=
      (hσind.comp (hfm i j i' j') (hgm i j i' j')).integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
        ((hfm i j i' j').comp hmeas).aestronglyMeasurable
        ((hgm i j i' j').comp σmeas).aestronglyMeasurable
    rw [key, L3_sign_moment μ σ σsign σfour hij hij']
    by_cases hD : (i' = i ∧ j' = j) ∨ (i' = j ∧ j' = i)
    · rw [if_pos hD, if_pos ⟨hij, hD⟩, mul_one, ← hcoll i j hij]
      refine L3_int_congr μ fun ω => ?_
      rcases hD with ⟨e1, e2⟩ | ⟨e1, e2⟩ <;> rw [e1, e2] <;> by_cases e : h ω i = h ω j
      all_goals first
        | (simp [hij, Ne.symm hij, e]; done)
        | simp [hij, Ne.symm hij, e, Ne.symm e]
    · rw [if_neg hD, if_neg (fun hh => hD hh.2), mul_zero]
  -- per-(i,j) bound on the surviving terms
  have hinner : ∀ i j : Fin n, ∑ i', ∑ j',
      (if i ≠ j ∧ ((i' = i ∧ j' = j) ∨ (i' = j ∧ j' = i)) then 1 / (r:ℝ) else 0) *
        (∑ a, ∑ b, U i a * U j b * U i' a * U j' b)
      ≤ ((∑ a, U i a ^ 2) * (∑ b, U j b ^ 2) + (∑ a, U i a * U j a) ^ 2) / r := by
    intro i j
    have hA : ∑ a, ∑ b, U i a * U j b * U i a * U j b = (∑ a, U i a ^ 2) * (∑ b, U j b ^ 2) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring
    have hG : ∑ a, ∑ b, U i a * U j b * U j a * U i b = (∑ a, U i a * U j a) ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ((∑ a, U i a ^ 2) * (∑ b, U j b ^ 2) + (∑ a, U i a * U j a) ^ 2) / r := by
      positivity
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i' _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j' _ => by
        rw [if_neg (fun hh => hh.1 hij), zero_mul])]
      exact hnn
    · have hsplit : ∀ i' j' : Fin n,
          (if i ≠ j ∧ ((i' = i ∧ j' = j) ∨ (i' = j ∧ j' = i)) then 1 / (r:ℝ) else 0)
          = (if i' = i ∧ j' = j then 1 / (r:ℝ) else 0) + (if i' = j ∧ j' = i then 1 / (r:ℝ) else 0) := by
        intro i' j'
        by_cases h1 : i' = i ∧ j' = j
        · rw [if_pos ⟨hij, Or.inl h1⟩, if_pos h1, if_neg (fun h2 => hij (h1.1.symm.trans h2.1)),
            add_zero]
        · by_cases h2 : i' = j ∧ j' = i
          · rw [if_pos ⟨hij, Or.inr h2⟩, if_neg h1, if_pos h2, zero_add]
          · rw [if_neg (fun hh => hh.2.elim h1 h2), if_neg h1, if_neg h2, add_zero]
      simp_rw [hsplit, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [L3_pick, L3_pick, hA, hG]
      exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  -- assemble
  rw [L3_int_congr μ (fun ω => L3_expand U (h ω) (σ ω)), L3_integral_sum4 _ hint']
  simp_rw [integral_mul_const, hE]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hinner i j).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [sq (∑ i, ∑ a, U i a ^ 2), Finset.sum_mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_div]

/-- L4: for a matrix with orthonormal columns, both Frobenius quantities equal the column count. -/
theorem L4 {n k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hU : U.transpose * U = 1) :
    ∑ i, ∑ a, U i a ^ 2 = k ∧ ∑ i, ∑ j, (∑ a, U i a * U j a) ^ 2 = k := by
  have h : ∀ a b, ∑ i, U i a * U i b = (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) a b := by
    intro a b
    have := congrFun (congrFun hU a) b
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply] using this
  constructor
  · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [sq, h, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    simp
  · have e : ∀ i j, (∑ a, U i a * U j a) ^ 2
        = ∑ a, ∑ b, (U i a * U i b) * (U j a * U j b) := by
      intro i j
      rw [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring
    simp_rw [e]
    calc ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ a, ∑ b, (U i a * U i b) * (U j a * U j b)
        = ∑ i, ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ j, (U i a * U i b) * (U j a * U j b) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _ = ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ i, ∑ j, (U i a * U i b) * (U j a * U j b) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _ = ∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, U i a * U i b) * (∑ j, U j a * U j b) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      _ = k := by
          simp_rw [h, Matrix.one_apply]
          simp

/-- L5: the column space of any real matrix has an orthonormal basis of size at most `d`. -/
theorem L5 {n d : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    ∃ k ≤ d, ∃ U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ, U.transpose * U = 1 ∧ ∀ x, ∃ z, A.mulVec x = U.mulVec z := by
  let f := Matrix.toEuclideanLin A
  let W := LinearMap.range f
  let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ W
  refine ⟨Module.finrank ℝ W, ?_,
    Matrix.of fun i a => WithLp.ofLp ((b a : W) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (LinearMap.finrank_range_le f).trans_eq finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
  · ext a c
    have h := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp b.orthonormal a c
    rw [Submodule.coe_inner, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct] at h
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ← h]
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, dotProduct, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _
  · intro x
    let w : W := ⟨f (WithLp.toLp 2 x), LinearMap.mem_range_self f _⟩
    refine ⟨fun a => b.repr w a, ?_⟩
    have hw := b.sum_repr w
    ext i
    have hi : ∑ a, b.repr w a * WithLp.ofLp ((b a : W) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) i
        = WithLp.ofLp ((w : W) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) i := by
      conv_rhs => rw [← hw]
      simp [Submodule.coe_sum, WithLp.ofLp_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
    have hA : WithLp.ofLp ((w : W) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) i = A.mulVec x i := rfl
    show A.mulVec x i = ∑ a, WithLp.ofLp ((b a : W) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) i * b.repr w a
    rw [← hA, ← hi]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => mul_comm _ _

/-- Helper: reorder a fourfold finite sum. -/
theorem H_sum4 {n k : ℕ} (g : Fin n → Fin n → Fin k → Fin k → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ a, ∑ b, g i j a b = ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ i, ∑ j, g i j a b := by
  calc ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ a, ∑ b, g i j a b
      = ∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, ∑ q : Fin k × Fin k, g p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 := by
        simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    _ = ∑ q : Fin k × Fin k, ∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, g p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ i, ∑ j, g i j a b := by simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type]

/-- Helper: the cross term for `v = U z` is a quadratic form in `z`. -/
theorem H_cross {n r k : ℕ} (h : Fin n → Fin r) (s : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (z : Fin k → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then s i * s j * U.mulVec z i * U.mulVec z j else 0) =
      ∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then s i * s j * U i a * U j b else 0)
        * z a * z b := by
  have lhs : ∀ i j, (if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then s i * s j * U.mulVec z i * U.mulVec z j else 0) =
      ∑ a, ∑ b, (if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then s i * s j * U i a * U j b else 0) * z a * z b := by
    intro i j
    have hv : ∀ i, U.mulVec z i = ∑ a, U i a * z a := fun i => rfl
    split_ifs
    · rw [hv i, hv j, mul_assoc, Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
      ring
    · simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => lhs i j]
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
  exact H_sum4 _

/-- Helper: orthonormal columns preserve the squared norm. -/
theorem H_norm {n k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hU : U.transpose * U = 1) (z : Fin k → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, (U.mulVec z i) ^ 2 = ∑ a, z a ^ 2 := by
  have e1 : ∑ i, (U.mulVec z i) ^ 2 = dotProduct (U.mulVec z) (U.mulVec z) := by
    simp [dotProduct, sq]
  rw [e1, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hU,
    Matrix.one_mulVec]
  simp [dotProduct, sq]

/-- Helper: the deterministic bound when the Frobenius quantity is at most `ε²`. -/
theorem H_det {n r k : ℕ} (h : Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Fin n → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ i, σ i = 1 ∨ σ i = -1)
    (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hU : U.transpose * U = 1) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hF : ∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then σ i * σ j * U i a * U j b else 0) ^ 2
      ≤ ε ^ 2) (z : Fin k → ℝ) :
    (1 - ε) * ∑ i, (U.mulVec z i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (sketch h σ (U.mulVec z) j) ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ j, (sketch h σ (U.mulVec z) j) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ∑ i, (U.mulVec z i) ^ 2 := by
  rw [L2 h σ hσ, H_cross h σ U z, H_norm U hU z]
  have h1 := L1 (fun a b => ∑ i, ∑ j,
    if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then σ i * σ j * U i a * U j b else 0) z
  beta_reduce at h1
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (∑ a, ∑ b,
      (∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then σ i * σ j * U i a * U j b else 0) ^ 2) ≤ ε := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_sq hε.le]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hF
  have h3 : 0 ≤ ∑ a, z a ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => sq_nonneg _
  have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 h3
  rw [abs_le] at h1
  constructor <;> nlinarith [h1.1, h1.2, h4]

/-- Helper: measurability of the cross-term entries. -/
theorem H_meas {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {n k r : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (h : Ω → Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hmeas : Measurable h) (σmeas : Measurable σ) :
    Measurable (fun ω => ∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, ∑ j,
      if i ≠ j ∧ h ω i = h ω j then σ ω i * σ ω j * U i a * U j b else 0) ^ 2) := by
  have hhi : ∀ i, Measurable fun ω => h ω i := fun i => (measurable_pi_apply i).comp hmeas
  have hσi : ∀ i, Measurable fun ω => σ ω i := fun i => (measurable_pi_apply i).comp σmeas
  have hset : ∀ i j, MeasurableSet {ω | i ≠ j ∧ h ω i = h ω j} := fun i j =>
    (MeasurableSet.const (i ≠ j)).inter (measurableSet_eq_fun (hhi i) (hhi j))
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun a _ => Finset.measurable_sum _ fun b _ => ?_
  refine Measurable.pow_const ?_ 2
  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => Finset.measurable_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
  exact Measurable.ite (hset i j)
    ((((hσi i).mul (hσi j)).mul_const _).mul_const _) measurable_const

/-- Helper: a uniform bound on the cross-term quantity. -/
theorem H_bound {n k r : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (h : Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ i = 1 ∨ σ i = -1) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then σ i * σ j * U i a * U j b else 0) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, ∑ j, |U i a * U j b|) ^ 2 := by
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => ?_
  have e : |∑ i, ∑ j, (if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then σ i * σ j * U i a * U j b else 0)|
      ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, |U i a * U j b| := by
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
    split_ifs
    · have hsi : |σ i| = 1 := by rcases hσ i with h' | h' <;> simp [h']
      have hsj : |σ j| = 1 := by rcases hσ j with h' | h' <;> simp [h']
      rw [show σ i * σ j * U i a * U j b = (σ i * σ j) * (U i a * U j b) by ring, abs_mul,
        abs_mul, hsi, hsj]
      simp
    · simp only [abs_zero]; exact abs_nonneg _
  rw [← sq_abs]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) e 2

/-! ## The modular chain

Layer 1 (algebra). `sketch_inner`: ⟨Su, Sw⟩ = ⟨u, w⟩ + colliding cross terms.
Layer 2 (approximate matrix multiplication, any matrix `U`). `ammErr` is the entry of
`(SU)ᵀ(SU) − UᵀU`; `amm_second_moment`: E‖(SU)ᵀ(SU) − UᵀU‖_F² ≤ 2‖U‖_F⁴ / r.
  Corollary `jl_moment` (the survey's Theorem 14 shape): E[(‖Sv‖² − ‖v‖²)²] ≤ 2‖v‖⁴ / r.
Layer 3 (tail). `amm_tail`: P(‖(SU)ᵀ(SU) − UᵀU‖_F² ≥ η²) ≤ 2‖U‖_F⁴ / (r η²), via `markov_tail`.
Layer 4 (deterministic lifting). `embedding_of_small_amm`: orthonormal `U` and a small AMM error
give the embedding on the column space of `U`; `L5` lifts it to any `A`.
Layer 5. `woodruff_theorem9`: layer 3 at η = ε with ‖U‖_F² = k ≤ d (`L4`), then layer 4.
-/

/-- Layer 1: the sketch preserves inner products up to the colliding cross terms. -/
theorem sketch_inner {n r : ℕ} (h : Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Fin n → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ i, σ i = 1 ∨ σ i = -1)
    (u w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∑ j, sketch h σ u j * sketch h σ w j =
      ∑ i, u i * w i + ∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then σ i * σ j * u i * w j else 0 := by
  have key : ∀ i i', (∑ j, (if h i = j then σ i * u i else 0) * (if h i' = j then σ i' * w i' else 0))
      = if h i = h i' then σ i * u i * (σ i' * w i') else 0 := by
    intro i i'
    simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    by_cases hh : h i = h i'
    · simp [hh]
    · simp [hh, Ne.symm hh]
  have split : ∀ i i', (if h i = h i' then σ i * u i * (σ i' * w i') else 0)
      = (if i = i' then u i * w i else 0)
        + (if i ≠ i' ∧ h i = h i' then σ i * σ i' * u i * w i' else 0) := by
    intro i i'
    by_cases hii : i = i'
    · subst hii
      have hs : σ i * σ i = 1 := by
        rcases hσ i with h1 | h1 <;> rw [h1] <;> norm_num
      simp only [if_true, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_and, if_false, add_zero]
      linear_combination (u i * w i) * hs
    · by_cases hh : h i = h i'
      · simp only [hh, hii, if_true, if_false, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, and_self, zero_add]
        ring
      · simp [hii, hh]
  calc
    ∑ j, sketch h σ u j * sketch h σ w j
        = ∑ i, ∑ i', ∑ j, (if h i = j then σ i * u i else 0) * (if h i' = j then σ i' * w i' else 0) := by
      unfold sketch
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ i', (if i = i' then u i * w i else 0)
          + ∑ i, ∑ i', (if i ≠ i' ∧ h i = h i' then σ i * σ i' * u i * w i' else 0) := by
      simp only [key, split, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = _ := by
      simp [Finset.sum_ite_eq]

/-- Entry `(a, b)` of the approximate-matrix-multiplication error `(SU)ᵀ(SU) − UᵀU`. -/
def ammErr {n r k : ℕ} (h : Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Fin n → ℝ) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (a b : Fin k) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, sketch h σ (fun i => U i a) j * sketch h σ (fun i => U i b) j - ∑ i, U i a * U i b

/-- Layer 1: the AMM error is exactly the colliding cross term. -/
theorem ammErr_eq_cross {n r k : ℕ} (h : Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ i = 1 ∨ σ i = -1) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (a b : Fin k) :
    ammErr h σ U a b = ∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ h i = h j then σ i * σ j * U i a * U j b else 0 := by
  unfold ammErr
  rw [sketch_inner h σ hσ]
  ring

/-- Cauchy–Schwarz on rows: ‖UUᵀ‖_F² ≤ ‖U‖_F⁴. -/
theorem gram_le_frob_sq {n k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (∑ a, U i a * U j a) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i, ∑ a, U i a ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [sq (∑ i, ∑ a, U i a ^ 2), Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
  exact Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _

/-- Layer 2: second moment of the AMM error, for any matrix `U`. -/
theorem amm_second_moment {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n k r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (h : Ω → Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hmeas : Measurable h) (σmeas : Measurable σ)
    (hpair : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → ∀ a b : Fin r,
      μ {ω | h ω i = a ∧ h ω j = b} = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (r : ℝ) ^ 2))
    (σsign : ∀ ω i, σ ω i = 1 ∨ σ ω i = -1)
    (σfour : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n), T.card ≤ 4 → T.Nonempty → ∫ ω, ∏ i ∈ T, σ ω i ∂μ = 0)
    (hσind : IndepFun h σ μ) :
    ∫ ω, ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ 2 * (∑ i, ∑ a, U i a ^ 2) ^ 2 / r := by
  have e : (fun ω => ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2) = fun ω => ∑ a, ∑ b,
      (∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ h ω i = h ω j then σ ω i * σ ω j * U i a * U j b else 0) ^ 2 := by
    funext ω; simp only [ammErr_eq_cross (h ω) (σ ω) (σsign ω)]
  rw [e]
  refine (L3 μ hr U h σ hmeas σmeas hpair σsign σfour hσind).trans ?_
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [gram_le_frob_sq U]) (Nat.cast_nonneg r)

/-- Layer 2 corollary, the shape of the survey's Theorem 14: E[(‖Sv‖² − ‖v‖²)²] ≤ 2‖v‖⁴ / r. -/
theorem jl_moment {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (v : Fin n → ℝ)
    (h : Ω → Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hmeas : Measurable h) (σmeas : Measurable σ)
    (hpair : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → ∀ a b : Fin r,
      μ {ω | h ω i = a ∧ h ω j = b} = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (r : ℝ) ^ 2))
    (σsign : ∀ ω i, σ ω i = 1 ∨ σ ω i = -1)
    (σfour : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n), T.card ≤ 4 → T.Nonempty → ∫ ω, ∏ i ∈ T, σ ω i ∂μ = 0)
    (hσind : IndepFun h σ μ) :
    ∫ ω, (∑ j, sketch (h ω) (σ ω) v j ^ 2 - ∑ i, v i ^ 2) ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ 2 * (∑ i, v i ^ 2) ^ 2 / r := by
  have hm := amm_second_moment μ hr (fun i (_ : Fin 1) => v i) h σ hmeas σmeas hpair σsign σfour
    hσind
  simpa [ammErr, sq] using hm

/-- Markov's inequality for a nonnegative integrable function with a bounded mean. -/
theorem markov_tail {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (F : Ω → ℝ) (hFnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ F ω) (hFint : Integrable F μ) {t c : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hE : ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ ≤ c) :
    μ {ω | t ≤ F ω} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c / t) := by
  have hMk := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hFnn) hFint t
  have hle : μ.real {ω | t ≤ F ω} ≤ c / t := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ht]; linarith
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ {ω | t ≤ F ω})]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hle

/-- Layer 3: tail bound for the AMM error, for any matrix `U`. -/
theorem amm_tail {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n k r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (h : Ω → Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hmeas : Measurable h) (σmeas : Measurable σ)
    (hpair : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → ∀ a b : Fin r,
      μ {ω | h ω i = a ∧ h ω j = b} = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (r : ℝ) ^ 2))
    (σsign : ∀ ω i, σ ω i = 1 ∨ σ ω i = -1)
    (σfour : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n), T.card ≤ 4 → T.Nonempty → ∫ ω, ∏ i ∈ T, σ ω i ∂μ = 0)
    (hσind : IndepFun h σ μ) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    μ {ω | η ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2}
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (∑ i, ∑ a, U i a ^ 2) ^ 2 / r / η ^ 2) := by
  have hFc : (fun ω => ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2) = fun ω => ∑ a, ∑ b,
      (∑ i, ∑ j, if i ≠ j ∧ h ω i = h ω j then σ ω i * σ ω j * U i a * U j b else 0) ^ 2 := by
    funext ω; simp only [ammErr_eq_cross (h ω) (σ ω) (σsign ω)]
  have hFnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2 := fun ω =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hFmeas : Measurable (fun ω => ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2) := by
    rw [hFc]; exact H_meas U h σ hmeas σmeas
  have hFint : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2) μ := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (integrable_const
      (∑ a, ∑ b, (∑ i, ∑ j, |U i a * U j b|) ^ 2)) hFmeas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hFnn ω)]
    simp only [ammErr_eq_cross (h ω) (σ ω) (σsign ω)]
    exact H_bound U (h ω) (σ ω) (σsign ω)
  exact markov_tail μ _ hFnn hFint (pow_pos hη 2)
    (amm_second_moment μ hr U h σ hmeas σmeas hpair σsign σfour hσind)

/-- Layer 4: for orthonormal `U`, a small AMM error gives the embedding on the column space. -/
theorem embedding_of_small_amm {n r k : ℕ} (h : Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hσ : ∀ i, σ i = 1 ∨ σ i = -1) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hU : U.transpose * U = 1)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hF : ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr h σ U a b ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ 2) (z : Fin k → ℝ) :
    (1 - ε) * ∑ i, (U.mulVec z i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (sketch h σ (U.mulVec z) j) ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ j, (sketch h σ (U.mulVec z) j) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ∑ i, (U.mulVec z i) ^ 2 := by
  simp only [ammErr_eq_cross h σ hσ] at hF
  exact H_det h σ hσ U hU ε hε hF z

/-- Layer 5: the survey's Theorem 9, with r ≥ 2d²/(δε²). -/
theorem woodruff_theorem9 {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n d r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (ε δ : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hr : 2 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2 / (δ * ε ^ 2) ≤ r)
    (h : Ω → Fin n → Fin r) (σ : Ω → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hmeas : Measurable h) (σmeas : Measurable σ)
    (hpair : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → ∀ a b : Fin r,
      μ {ω | h ω i = a ∧ h ω j = b} = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (r : ℝ) ^ 2))
    (σsign : ∀ ω i, σ ω i = 1 ∨ σ ω i = -1)
    (σfour : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n), T.card ≤ 4 → T.Nonempty → ∫ ω, ∏ i ∈ T, σ ω i ∂μ = 0)
    (hσind : IndepFun h σ μ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (1 - δ) ≤ μ {ω | ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ,
      (1 - ε) * ∑ i, (A.mulVec x i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (A.mulVec x) j) ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ j, (sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (A.mulVec x) j) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ∑ i, (A.mulVec x i) ^ 2} := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with hd | hd
  · subst hd
    have hA : ∀ x, A.mulVec x = 0 := fun x => by ext i; simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    have hset : {ω | ∀ x : Fin 0 → ℝ,
        (1 - ε) * ∑ i, (A.mulVec x i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (A.mulVec x) j) ^ 2 ∧
        ∑ j, (sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (A.mulVec x) j) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ∑ i, (A.mulVec x i) ^ 2}
        = Set.univ := by
      ext ω; simp [hA, sketch]
    rw [hset, measure_univ]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_one.mpr (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨k, hk, U, hU, hAU⟩ := L5 A
  have hd' : (0 : ℝ) < d := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hd
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (div_pos (mul_pos two_pos (pow_pos hd' 2)) (mul_pos hδ (pow_pos hε 2))) hr
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by exact_mod_cast hr0
  -- Layer 3 at η = ε, with ‖U‖_F² = k ≤ d.
  have hS : μ {ω | ε ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
    refine (amm_tail μ hrpos U h σ hmeas σmeas hpair σsign σfour hσind hε).trans
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
    rw [(L4 U hU).1]
    have hkd : (k : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
    have hkk : (k : ℝ) * k ≤ d * d := mul_le_mul hkd hkd hk0 hd'.le
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hε 2), div_le_iff₀ hr0]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos hδ (pow_pos hε 2))] at hr
    nlinarith
  -- Layer 4 on the complement, lifted to `A` by `L5`.
  have hsub : {ω | ε ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2}ᶜ ⊆ {ω | ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ,
      (1 - ε) * ∑ i, (A.mulVec x i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, (sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (A.mulVec x) j) ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ j, (sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (A.mulVec x) j) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ∑ i, (A.mulVec x i) ^ 2} := by
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_le] at hω
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro x
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hAU x
    rw [hz]
    exact embedding_of_small_amm (h ω) (σ ω) (σsign ω) U hU ε hε hω.le z
  calc ENNReal.ofReal (1 - δ) = 1 - ENNReal.ofReal δ := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ hδ.le, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    _ ≤ 1 - μ {ω | ε ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2} := tsub_le_tsub_left hS 1
    _ ≤ μ {ω | ε ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2}ᶜ := by
        rw [tsub_le_iff_left]
        calc (1 : ENNReal) = μ ({ω | ε ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2} ∪
              {ω | ε ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a, ∑ b, ammErr (h ω) (σ ω) U a b ^ 2}ᶜ) := by
              rw [Set.union_compl_self, measure_univ]
          _ ≤ _ := measure_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := measure_mono hsub

open Matrix

namespace BSS

/-- Positive definiteness, as a quadratic-form condition. -/
def pd {k : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, x ≠ 0 → 0 < x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x)

/-- Spectral theorem for real symmetric matrices. -/
theorem spectral {k : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (hA : A.transpose = A) :
    ∃ U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ, ∃ μ : Fin k → ℝ, U.transpose * U = 1 ∧ U * U.transpose = 1 ∧
      A = U * diagonal μ * U.transpose := by
  have hH : A.IsHermitian := by
    unfold Matrix.IsHermitian; rw [conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]; exact hA
  have hstar : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ, star M = M.transpose := fun M => by
    rw [star_eq_conjTranspose, conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
  have hmem := hH.eigenvectorUnitary.2
  refine ⟨(hH.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ), hH.eigenvalues, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hstar]; exact Unitary.star_mul_self_of_mem hmem
  · rw [← hstar]; exact Unitary.mul_star_self_of_mem hmem
  · conv_lhs => rw [hH.spectral_theorem]
    rw [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply, hstar]
    congr 2

section conj

variable {k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (hU1 : U.transpose * U = 1)
  (hU2 : U * U.transpose = 1)
include hU1

theorem conj_mul (d e : Fin k → ℝ) :
    U * diagonal d * U.transpose * (U * diagonal e * U.transpose) =
      U * diagonal (fun j => d j * e j) * U.transpose := by
  have : U * diagonal d * U.transpose * (U * diagonal e * U.transpose)
      = U * diagonal d * (U.transpose * U) * diagonal e * U.transpose := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [this, hU1, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc U, diagonal_mul_diagonal]

theorem conj_inv (hU2 : U * U.transpose = 1) (μ : Fin k → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ j, μ j ≠ 0) :
    (U * diagonal μ * U.transpose)⁻¹ = U * diagonal (fun j => (μ j)⁻¹) * U.transpose := by
  apply inv_eq_right_inv
  rw [conj_mul U hU1]
  have : (fun j => μ j * (μ j)⁻¹) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := funext fun j => mul_inv_cancel₀ (hμ j)
  rw [this, diagonal_one, Matrix.mul_one]
  exact hU2
omit hU1 in
theorem conj_trace (hU1 : U.transpose * U = 1) (d : Fin k → ℝ) :
    trace (U * diagonal d * U.transpose) = ∑ j, d j := by
  rw [trace_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hU1, Matrix.one_mul, trace_diagonal]

omit hU1 in
theorem conj_quad (d : Fin k → ℝ) (x : Fin k → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ ((U * diagonal d * U.transpose) *ᵥ x) = ∑ j, d j * (U.transpose *ᵥ x) j ^ 2 := by
  rw [← mulVec_mulVec, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec, ← mulVec_transpose]
  simp only [dotProduct, mulVec_diagonal]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring

omit hU1 in
theorem conj_sub (hU2 : U * U.transpose = 1) (μ : Fin k → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    U * diagonal μ * U.transpose - c • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) =
      U * diagonal (fun j => μ j - c) * U.transpose := by
  have h1 : c • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) = U * diagonal (fun _ => c) * U.transpose := by
    rw [show diagonal (fun _ => c) = c • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) by
      ext i j; simp [diagonal_apply, one_apply]]
    rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, hU2]
  rw [h1, ← Matrix.sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sub, ← diagonal_sub]

omit hU1 in
theorem pd_of_pos (hU2 : U * U.transpose = 1) (μ : Fin k → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ j, 0 < μ j) :
    pd (U * diagonal μ * U.transpose) := by
  intro x hx
  rw [conj_quad]
  have hy : U.transpose *ᵥ x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hx
    have : U *ᵥ (U.transpose *ᵥ x) = x := by rw [mulVec_mulVec, hU2, one_mulVec]
    rw [← this, h0, mulVec_zero]
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hy
  apply Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hμ i).le (sq_nonneg _))
  exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, mul_pos (hμ j) (lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (pow_ne_zero 2 hj)))⟩

theorem pos_of_pd (μ : Fin k → ℝ) (h : pd (U * diagonal μ * U.transpose)) (j : Fin k) :
    0 < μ j := by
  have he : U.transpose *ᵥ (U *ᵥ Pi.single j 1) = Pi.single j 1 := by
    rw [mulVec_mulVec, hU1, one_mulVec]
  have hx : U *ᵥ Pi.single j 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, mulVec_zero] at he
    have := congrFun he j
    simp at this
  have := h _ hx
  rw [conj_quad, he] at this
  simpa [Pi.single_apply] using this

end conj

/-! ## Sherman–Morrison, trace form -/

theorem sherman_morrison {k : ℕ} (M P : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (hMP : M * P = 1)
    (hP : P.transpose = P) (v : Fin k → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hden : 1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v)) ≠ 0) :
    (M + t • vecMulVec v v)⁻¹ =
      P - (t / (1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v)))) • vecMulVec (P *ᵥ v) (P *ᵥ v) := by
  apply inv_eq_right_inv
  set q := v ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v) with hq
  set c := t / (1 + t * q) with hc
  have hvP : v ᵥ* P = P *ᵥ v := by rw [← mulVec_transpose, hP]
  have e1 : M * vecMulVec (P *ᵥ v) (P *ᵥ v) = vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [mul_vecMulVec, mulVec_mulVec, hMP, one_mulVec]
  have e2 : vecMulVec v v * P = vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) := by rw [vecMulVec_mul, hvP]
  have e3 : vecMulVec v v * vecMulVec (P *ᵥ v) (P *ᵥ v) = q • vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, vecMulVec_smul]
  have hcq : t - c - c * t * q = 0 := by
    rw [hc]; field_simp; ring
  rw [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, hMP, Matrix.mul_smul, e1, Matrix.smul_mul,
    e2, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, e3, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  have : (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - c • vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) +
      (t • vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) - (t * c * q) • vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v))
      = 1 + (t - c - c * t * q) • vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) := by
    module
  rw [this, hcq, zero_smul, add_zero]

theorem sm_trace {k : ℕ} (M P : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (hMP : M * P = 1)
    (hP : P.transpose = P) (v : Fin k → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hden : 1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v)) ≠ 0) :
    trace (M + t • vecMulVec v v)⁻¹ =
      trace P - t / (1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v))) * ((P *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v)) := by
  rw [sherman_morrison M P hMP hP v t hden, trace_sub, trace_smul, trace_vecMulVec, smul_eq_mul]


/-! ## Quadratic forms -/

theorem quad_rank1 {k : ℕ} (u x : Fin k → ℝ) : x ⬝ᵥ (vecMulVec u u *ᵥ x) = (u ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := by
  simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, vecMulVec_apply, sq, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring

theorem quad_add {k : ℕ} (M N : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (x : Fin k → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ ((M + N) *ᵥ x) = x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) + x ⬝ᵥ (N *ᵥ x) := by
  rw [add_mulVec, dotProduct_add]

theorem quad_smul {k : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (x : Fin k → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ ((c • M) *ᵥ x) = c * x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) := by
  rw [smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]

theorem quad_one {k : ℕ} (x : Fin k → ℝ) : x ⬝ᵥ ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) *ᵥ x) = ∑ b, x b ^ 2 := by
  rw [one_mulVec]; simp [dotProduct, sq]

theorem quad_sum {n k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (f : Fin n → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (x : Fin k → ℝ) : x ⬝ᵥ ((∑ i ∈ S, f i) *ᵥ x) = ∑ i ∈ S, x ⬝ᵥ (f i *ᵥ x) := by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i S hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, quad_add, ih]

/-- The sparsifier Σᵢ sᵢ vᵢvᵢᵀ. -/
noncomputable def Aof {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ) (s : Fin n → ℝ) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ :=
  ∑ i, s i • vecMulVec (v i) (v i)

theorem Aof_quad {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ) (s : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Fin k → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (Aof v s *ᵥ x) = ∑ i, s i * (v i ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := by
  unfold Aof
  rw [quad_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [quad_smul, quad_rank1]

theorem Aof_symm {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ) (s : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (Aof v s).transpose = Aof v s := by
  unfold Aof
  rw [transpose_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [transpose_smul, transpose_vecMulVec]

/-! ## The scalar inequality behind the averaging step -/

theorem key_ineq {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (μ : Fin k → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ j, 0 < μ j)
    (hΦ : ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹ < 1) :
    (∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹ - (μ j + 1)⁻¹)) * (1 - ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹) <
      ∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹) ^ 2 - (∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹ - (μ j + 1)⁻¹)) * ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ := by
  set a : Fin k → ℝ := fun j => (μ j)⁻¹ with ha
  set b : Fin k → ℝ := fun j => (μ j + 1)⁻¹ with hb
  have hab : ∀ j, a j - b j = a j * b j := fun j => by
    simp only [ha, hb]; field_simp [(hμ j).ne', (by linarith [hμ j] : μ j + 1 ≠ 0)]; ring
  have ha0 : ∀ j, 0 < a j := fun j => inv_pos.mpr (hμ j)
  have hb0 : ∀ j, 0 < b j := fun j => inv_pos.mpr (by linarith [hμ j])
  have hD : ∑ j, (a j - b j) = ∑ j, a j * b j := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hab j
  have hA : ∑ j, a j = ∑ j, a j * b j + ∑ j, b j := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by linarith [hab j]
  have hA2 : ∑ j, a j ^ 2 = ∑ j, a j * b j + ∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    have h := hab j
    calc a j ^ 2 = a j * (a j - b j) + a j * b j := by ring
      _ = a j * (a j * b j) + a j * b j := by rw [h]
      _ = a j * b j + a j ^ 2 * b j := by ring
  -- Cauchy–Schwarz: (Σ ab)² ≤ (Σ a²b)(Σ b)
  have hcs : (∑ j, a j * b j) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j) * ∑ j, b j := by
    have := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ (fun j => a j * Real.sqrt (b j))
      (fun j => Real.sqrt (b j))
    have e1 : ∀ j, a j * Real.sqrt (b j) * Real.sqrt (b j) = a j * b j := fun j => by
      rw [mul_assoc, Real.mul_self_sqrt (hb0 j).le]
    have e2 : ∀ j, (a j * Real.sqrt (b j)) ^ 2 = a j ^ 2 * b j := fun j => by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hb0 j).le]
    have e3 : ∀ j, Real.sqrt (b j) ^ 2 = b j := fun j => Real.sq_sqrt (hb0 j).le
    simp only [e1, e2, e3] at this
    exact this
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j := by
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, hk⟩⟩
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => mul_pos (pow_pos (ha0 j) 2) (hb0 j)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hlt : (∑ j, a j * b j) ^ 2 < ∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j := by
    calc (∑ j, a j * b j) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j) * ∑ j, b j := hcs
      _ < (∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j) * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hΦ hpos
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  show (∑ j, (a j - b j)) * (1 - ∑ j, b j) < ∑ j, a j ^ 2 - (∑ j, (a j - b j)) * ∑ j, a j
  rw [hD, hA2, hA]
  nlinarith [hlt]


/-! ## One barrier step -/

theorem sum_rank1_conj {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ a b : Fin k, ∑ i, v i a * v i b = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (hU1 : U.transpose * U = 1) (j : Fin k) :
    ∑ i, ((U.transpose *ᵥ v i) j) ^ 2 = 1 := by
  have hV : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) := by
    ext a b
    rw [Matrix.sum_apply]
    simp only [vecMulVec_apply, one_apply]
    exact hv a b
  have hconj : ∀ x : Fin k → ℝ,
      vecMulVec (U.transpose *ᵥ x) (U.transpose *ᵥ x) = U.transpose * vecMulVec x x * U := by
    intro x
    rw [mul_vecMulVec, vecMulVec_mul, ← mulVec_transpose]
  have hsum : ∑ i, vecMulVec (U.transpose *ᵥ v i) (U.transpose *ᵥ v i) = 1 := by
    simp only [hconj]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, hV, Matrix.mul_one, hU1]
  have := congrFun (congrFun hsum j) j
  rw [Matrix.sum_apply] at this
  simpa [vecMulVec_apply, sq] using this

theorem step {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ a b : Fin k, ∑ i, v i a * v i b = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (w : Fin n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (φ0 : ℝ) (hφ0 : φ0 < 1)
    (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (L : ℝ)
    (hpd : pd (A - L • 1)) (hΦ : trace (A - L • 1)⁻¹ ≤ φ0) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t * w i ≤ (∑ j, w j) / (1 - φ0) ∧
      pd (A + t • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) - (L + 1) • 1) ∧
      trace (A + t • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) - (L + 1) • 1)⁻¹ ≤ φ0 := by
  have hsym : (A - L • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)).transpose = A - L • 1 := by
    rw [transpose_sub, transpose_smul, transpose_one, hA]
  obtain ⟨U, β, hU1, hU2, hB⟩ := spectral _ hsym
  have hβ : ∀ j, 0 < β j := pos_of_pd U hU1 β (hB ▸ hpd)
  have hΦeq : trace (A - L • 1)⁻¹ = ∑ j, (β j)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hB, conj_inv U hU1 hU2 β (fun j => (hβ j).ne'), conj_trace U hU1]
  have hβ1 : ∀ j, 1 < β j := by
    intro j
    have h1 : (β j)⁻¹ ≤ ∑ j, (β j)⁻¹ :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => (inv_pos.mpr (hβ i)).le) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have h2 : (β j)⁻¹ < 1 := by linarith
    by_contra h3
    have h4 : 1 ≤ (β j)⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ (hβ j)).mpr (not_lt.mp h3)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨μ, hμdef⟩ : ∃ μ : Fin k → ℝ, ∀ j, μ j = β j - 1 := ⟨fun j => β j - 1, fun j => rfl⟩
  have hμ : ∀ j, 0 < μ j := fun j => by rw [hμdef]; linarith [hβ1 j]
  have hβμ : ∀ j, β j = μ j + 1 := fun j => by rw [hμdef]; ring
  have hM : A - (L + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) = U * diagonal μ * U.transpose := by
    have h := conj_sub U hU2 β 1
    rw [one_smul, ← hB] at h
    have hd : (fun j => β j - 1) = μ := funext fun j => (hμdef j).symm
    rw [hd] at h
    rw [← h, add_smul, one_smul, sub_sub]
  have hMpd : pd (A - (L + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)) := by
    rw [hM]; exact pd_of_pos U hU2 μ hμ
  set P : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ := U * diagonal (fun j => (μ j)⁻¹) * U.transpose with hPdef
  have hMP : (A - (L + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)) * P = 1 := by
    rw [hM, hPdef, conj_mul U hU1]
    have : (fun j => μ j * (μ j)⁻¹) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := funext fun j => mul_inv_cancel₀ (hμ j).ne'
    rw [this, diagonal_one, Matrix.mul_one, hU2]
  have hPsym : P.transpose = P := by
    rw [hPdef, transpose_mul, transpose_mul, transpose_transpose, diagonal_transpose,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  clear_value P
  have hq1 : ∀ i, v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) = ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ * ((U.transpose *ᵥ v i) j) ^ 2 := fun i => by
    rw [hPdef, conj_quad]
  have hq2 : ∀ i, (P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) =
      ∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹ * (μ j)⁻¹) * ((U.transpose *ᵥ v i) j) ^ 2 := fun i => by
    have e : (P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) = v i ⬝ᵥ ((P * P) *ᵥ v i) := by
      rw [← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec, ← mulVec_transpose, hPsym, dotProduct_comm]
    rw [e, hPdef, conj_mul U hU1, conj_quad]
  have hvt := sum_rank1_conj v hv U hU1
  have hsum1 : ∑ i, v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) = ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [hq1]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hvt j, mul_one]
  have hsum2 : ∑ i, (P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) = ∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [hq2]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hvt j, mul_one, sq]
  have hΦμ : trace (A - L • 1)⁻¹ = ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hΦeq]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [hβμ]
  have htrP : trace P = ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ := by rw [hPdef, conj_trace U hU1]
  set D := ∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹ - (μ j + 1)⁻¹) with hD
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, hk⟩⟩
    refine Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => ?_) Finset.univ_nonempty
    have := (inv_lt_inv₀ (by linarith [hμ j]) (hμ j)).mpr (by linarith : μ j < μ j + 1)
    linarith
  have hΦlt : ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹ < 1 := by rw [← hΦμ]; linarith
  have key := key_ineq hk μ hμ hΦlt
  rw [← hD] at key
  set W := ∑ j, w j with hW
  set c : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) - D * (v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i)) with hc
  set e : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => D * w i * (1 - φ0) / W with he
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hw i
  have he0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i := fun i => by
    simp only [he]; exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hDpos.le (hw i)) (by linarith)) hW0
  have hsume : ∑ i, e i ≤ D * (1 - φ0) := by
    have : ∑ i, e i = D * (1 - φ0) / W * W := by
      calc ∑ i, e i = ∑ i, D * (1 - φ0) / W * w i :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [he]; ring
        _ = D * (1 - φ0) / W * ∑ i, w i := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ = D * (1 - φ0) / W * W := by rw [hW]
    rw [this]
    by_cases h0 : W = 0
    · rw [h0, mul_zero]; exact mul_nonneg hDpos.le (by linarith)
    · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ h0]
  have hsumc : ∑ i, c i = ∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹) ^ 2 - D * ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [hc]; rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hsum1, hsum2]
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ i, (c i - e i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsumc]
    have h1 : D * (1 - φ0) ≤ D * (1 - ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by rw [← hΦμ]; linarith) hDpos.le
    linarith
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, 0 < c i - e i := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have : ∑ i, (c i - e i) ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos fun i _ => h i
    linarith
  have hci : 0 < c i := by linarith [he0 i]
  refine ⟨i, D / c i, div_pos hDpos hci, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- the trace (upper) budget
    by_cases h0 : W = 0
    · have hwi : w i = 0 := le_antisymm
        ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hw j) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans h0.le) (hw i)
      rw [hwi, mul_zero, h0, zero_div]
    · have hWpos : 0 < W := lt_of_le_of_ne hW0 (Ne.symm h0)
      have h1 : D * w i * (1 - φ0) < c i * W := by
        have : e i < c i := by linarith
        simp only [he] at this
        exact (div_lt_iff₀ hWpos).mp this
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hci (by linarith)]
      linarith
  · intro x hx
    rw [show A + (D / c i) • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) - (L + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
        = (A - (L + 1) • 1) + (D / c i) • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) by abel,
      quad_add, quad_smul, quad_rank1]
    have := hMpd x hx
    have : 0 ≤ D / c i * (v i ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (div_pos hDpos hci).le (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  · have hq1n : 0 ≤ v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) := by
      rw [hq1]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr (hμ j)).le (sq_nonneg _)
    have hden : 1 + D / c i * (v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i)) ≠ 0 := by
      have := mul_nonneg (div_pos hDpos hci).le hq1n
      linarith
    rw [show A + (D / c i) • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) - (L + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
        = (A - (L + 1) • 1) + (D / c i) • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) by abel,
      sm_trace _ P hMP hPsym (v i) _ hden, htrP]
    have hcdef : c i = (P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) - D * (v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i)) := rfl
    have hdrop : D / c i / (1 + D / c i * (v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i))) * ((P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i)) = D := by
      field_simp
      rw [hcdef]
      ring
    rw [hdrop]
    have : ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ - D = ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹ := by
      rw [hD, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; ring
    rw [this, ← hΦμ]
    exact hΦ

/-! ## Iterating the step -/

theorem iterate {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ a b : Fin k, ∑ i, v i a * v i b = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (w : Fin n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (φ0 : ℝ) (hφ0 : φ0 < 1) (L0 : ℝ)
    (hbpd : pd ((0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - L0 • 1))
    (hbtr : trace ((0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - L0 • 1)⁻¹ ≤ φ0) :
    ∀ τ : ℕ, ∃ s : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i ≠ 0).card ≤ τ ∧
      ∑ i, s i * w i ≤ τ * ((∑ j, w j) / (1 - φ0)) ∧
      pd (Aof v s - (L0 + τ) • 1) ∧ trace (Aof v s - (L0 + τ) • 1)⁻¹ ≤ φ0
  | 0 => by
    have h0 : Aof v (0 : Fin n → ℝ) = 0 := by simp [Aof]
    refine ⟨0, fun i => le_refl _, by simp, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h0]; simpa using hbpd
    · rw [h0]; simpa using hbtr
  | τ + 1 => by
    obtain ⟨s, hs0, hcard, hwt, hpd, htr⟩ := iterate hk v hv w hw φ0 hφ0 L0 hbpd hbtr τ
    obtain ⟨i, t, ht, htw, hpd', htr'⟩ :=
      step hk v hv w hw φ0 hφ0 (Aof v s) (Aof_symm v s) (L0 + τ) hpd htr
    set s' : Fin n → ℝ := fun j => s j + if j = i then t else 0 with hs'
    have hA' : Aof v s' = Aof v s + t • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
      unfold Aof
      simp only [hs', add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
        Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    have hL : L0 + ((τ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = L0 + τ + 1 := by push_cast; ring
    refine ⟨s', fun j => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [hs']; split_ifs <;> linarith [hs0 j]
    · have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s' j ≠ 0) ⊆
          insert i (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s j ≠ 0) := by
        intro j hj
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert] at hj ⊢
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · exact Or.inl hji
        · right; simpa [hs', hji] using hj

          ≤ (insert i (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s j ≠ 0)).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
        _ ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s j ≠ 0).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le _ _

        simp only [hs', add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
          Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
      rw [this]; push_cast; linarith
    · rw [hA', hL]; exact hpd'
    · rw [hA', hL]; exact htr'

end BSS

theorem woodruff_theorem50 {n k ℓ : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ a b : Fin k, ∑ i, v i a * v i b = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (a : Fin n → Fin ℓ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (hkn : k < n) (hkr : k < r) (hrn : r ≤ n) :
    ∃ s : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i ≠ 0).card ≤ r ∧
      (∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, (1 - Real.sqrt (k / r)) ^ 2 * ∑ b, x b ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ i, s i * (∑ b, v i b * x b) ^ 2) ∧
      ∑ i, s i * ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
  · subst hk
    refine ⟨0, fun i => le_refl _, by simp, fun x => by simp, ?_⟩
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (lt_trans hk hkr)
  set φ0 := Real.sqrt (k / r) with hφ0def
  have hφ0 : φ0 < 1 := by
    rw [hφ0def, Real.sqrt_lt' one_pos, one_pow]
    exact (div_lt_one hr0).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hkr)
  have hφ0nn : 0 ≤ φ0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  set c := Real.sqrt (r * k) with hcdef
  have hc0 : 0 < c := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hrc : c = r * φ0 := by
    rw [hcdef, hφ0def, show (r : ℝ) * k = r ^ 2 * (k / r) by field_simp,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hr0.le]
  -- base of the barrier: A = 0, L0 = -c
  have hbase : (0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - (-c) • 1 = c • 1 := by
    rw [zero_sub, neg_smul, neg_neg]
  have hbpd : pd ((0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - (-c) • 1) := by
    rw [hbase]
    intro x hx
    rw [quad_smul, quad_one]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hx
    have : 0 < ∑ b, x b ^ 2 := Finset.sum_pos' (fun b _ => sq_nonneg _)
      ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (pow_ne_zero 2 hj))⟩
    positivity
  have hbtr : trace ((0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - (-c) • 1)⁻¹ ≤ φ0 := by
    rw [hbase]
    have hinv : (c • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ))⁻¹ = c⁻¹ • 1 := by
      apply inv_eq_right_inv
      rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, Matrix.one_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc0.ne', one_smul]
    rw [hinv, trace_smul, trace_one, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
    have e : φ0 * c = k := by
      rw [hφ0def, hcdef, ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity),
        show (k : ℝ) / r * (r * k) = k ^ 2 by field_simp, Real.sqrt_sq hk0.le]
    apply le_of_eq
    rw [← e]; field_simp
  set w : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 with hwdef
  have hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i := fun i => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hcard, hwt, hpd, -⟩ := iterate hk v hv w hw φ0 hφ0 (-c) hbpd hbtr r
  have hLr : -c + (r : ℝ) = r * (1 - φ0) := by rw [hrc]; ring
  rw [hLr] at hpd
  have hquad : ∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, r * (1 - φ0) * ∑ b, x b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, s i * (v i ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · subst hx; simp
    · have := hpd x hx
      rw [sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, quad_smul, quad_one, Aof_quad] at this
      linarith
  have hf0 : 0 < (1 - φ0) / r := div_pos (by linarith) hr0
  refine ⟨fun i => (1 - φ0) / r * s i, fun i => mul_nonneg hf0.le (hs0 i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => (1 - φ0) / r * s i ≠ 0) =
        Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i ≠ 0 := by
      ext i; simp [hf0.ne']
    rw [this]; exact hcard
  · intro x
    have h := hquad x
    have e : ∑ i, (1 - φ0) / r * s i * (∑ b, v i b * x b) ^ 2 =
        (1 - φ0) / r * ∑ i, s i * (v i ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [dotProduct]; ring
    rw [e]
    calc (1 - φ0) ^ 2 * ∑ b, x b ^ 2 = (1 - φ0) / r * (r * (1 - φ0) * ∑ b, x b ^ 2) := by
          field_simp [show (1 : ℝ) - φ0 ≠ 0 by linarith, hr0.ne']
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hf0.le
  · have e : ∑ i, (1 - φ0) / r * s i * ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 = (1 - φ0) / r * ∑ i, s i * w i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [hwdef]; ring
    rw [e]
    calc (1 - φ0) / r * ∑ i, s i * w i ≤ (1 - φ0) / r * (r * ((∑ j, w j) / (1 - φ0))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwt hf0.le
      _ = ∑ j, w j := by field_simp [show (1 : ℝ) - φ0 ≠ 0 by linarith, hr0.ne']

theorem woodruff_corollary54 {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {n k ℓ ξ : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ a b : Fin k, ∑ i, v i a * v i b = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (a : Fin n → Fin ℓ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (hkn : k < n) (hkr : k < r) (hrn : r ≤ n)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (hξ : 200 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / ε ^ 2 ≤ ξ)
    (h : Ω → Fin ℓ → Fin ξ) (σ : Ω → Fin ℓ → ℝ)
    (hmeas : Measurable h) (σmeas : Measurable σ)
    (hpair : ∀ i j : Fin ℓ, i ≠ j → ∀ a b : Fin ξ,
      μ {ω | h ω i = a ∧ h ω j = b} = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (ξ : ℝ) ^ 2))
    (σsign : ∀ ω i, σ ω i = 1 ∨ σ ω i = -1)
    (σfour : ∀ T : Finset (Fin ℓ), T.card ≤ 4 → T.Nonempty → ∫ ω, ∏ i ∈ T, σ ω i ∂μ = 0)
    (hσind : IndepFun h σ μ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal 0.99 ≤ μ {ω |
      (∃ s : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i ≠ 0).card ≤ r ∧
        (∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, (1 - Real.sqrt (k / r)) ^ 2 * ∑ b, x b ^ 2 ≤
          ∑ i, s i * (∑ b, v i b * x b) ^ 2) ∧
        ∑ i, s i * ∑ j, sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (a i) j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (a i) j ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ s : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) →
        ∑ i, s i * ∑ j, sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (a i) j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (a i) j ^ 2 →
        ∑ i, s i * ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) / (1 - ε) * ∑ i, ∑ j, a i j ^ 2} := by
  -- the embedding event of our Theorem 9, applied to the ℓ×n matrix with columns aᵢ
  set A' : Matrix (Fin ℓ) (Fin n) ℝ := fun j i => a i j with hA'
  have hr9 : 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((1 / 100) * ε ^ 2) ≤ ξ := by
    have : 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / ((1 / 100) * ε ^ 2) = 200 * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 / ε ^ 2 := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [this]; exact hξ
  have h9 := woodruff_theorem9 μ A' ε (1 / 100) hε (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hr9 h σ hmeas
    σmeas hpair σsign σfour hσind
  have hcol : ∀ i, A'.mulVec (Pi.single i 1) = a i := fun i => by
    ext j; simp [hA', Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply]
  calc ENNReal.ofReal 0.99 = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - 1 / 100) := by norm_num
    _ ≤ _ := h9
    _ ≤ _ := measure_mono fun ω hω => by
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω ⊢
      set b : Fin n → Fin ξ → ℝ := fun i => sketch (h ω) (σ ω) (a i) with hb
      have hemb : ∀ i, (1 - ε) * ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 ∧
          ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 := fun i => by
        have := hω (Pi.single i 1)
        rw [hcol i] at this
        exact this
      refine ⟨woodruff_theorem50 v hv b r hkn hkr hrn, fun s hs hsb => ?_⟩
      have h1 : (1 - ε) * ∑ i, s i * ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, s i * ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hemb i).1 (hs i)
          linarith
      have h2 : ∑ i, ∑ j, b i j ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ε) * ∑ i, ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => (hemb i).2
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
      nlinarith

/-!

in a second-moment variant (our own statement and proof; DEC with the user, 2026-11-11).

Survey text: "Suppose Z ∈ ℝ^{n×k} has orthonormal columns. Suppose s > 144k ln(2k/δ)/(βε²) and
Ω and D are constructed from the RandSampling(Z, s, q) procedure. Then with probability at least
1 − δ, simultaneously for all i, 1 − ε ≤ σᵢ²(ZᵀΩD) ≤ 1 + ε."

Variant, recorded as a departure: the sample size is s ≥ k²/(ε²δ) instead of
s > 144k ln(2k/δ)/(βε²). The survey's bound needs a matrix Chernoff inequality; ours needs only
second moments and Markov, at the price of k² instead of k log k. As in Lemma 55, q = p (β = 1).

Encoding.
* RandSampling (Definition 16): `I ω j` is the j-th sampled row index, with law
  P(I j = i) = pᵢ = ‖eᵢᵀZ‖²/k, and the samples are pairwise independent (Definition 16 picks them
  independently, which implies this). ΩD is `sampleMat`, as in our Lemma 49 file.
* "1 − ε ≤ σᵢ²(ZᵀΩD) ≤ 1 + ε for all i" is the equivalent quadratic-form statement
  (1 − ε)‖x‖² ≤ ‖(ZᵀΩD)ᵀx‖² ≤ (1 + ε)‖x‖² for all x ∈ ℝᵏ.
-/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

/-- The product ΩD of RandSampling: column j is e_{I j} scaled by 1/√(q_{I j} s). -/
noncomputable def sampleMat {n s : ℕ} (I : Fin s → Fin n) (q : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Matrix (Fin n) (Fin s) ℝ :=
  fun i j => if I j = i then 1 / Real.sqrt (q i * s) else 0

theorem integ_fin {Ω β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [Fintype β] [MeasurableSpace β] [MeasurableSingletonClass β]
    (Y : Ω → β) (hY : Measurable Y) (Φ : β → ℝ) : Integrable (fun ω => Φ (Y ω)) μ := by
  refine Integrable.of_bound ((measurable_of_finite Φ).comp hY).aestronglyMeasurable
    (∑ y, |Φ y|) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun y => |Φ y|) (fun y _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ (Y ω))

/-- Expectation of a function of a discrete random variable with a known law. -/
theorem int_law {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {n : ℕ}
    (X : Ω → Fin n) (hX : Measurable X) (p : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hlaw : ∀ i, μ {ω | X ω = i} = ENNReal.ofReal (p i)) (g : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, g (X ω) ∂μ = ∑ i, g i * p i := by
  have hms : ∀ i, MeasurableSet {ω | X ω = i} := fun i => hX (measurableSet_singleton i)
  have hpt : (fun ω => g (X ω)) = fun ω => ∑ i, {ω' | X ω' = i}.indicator (fun _ => g i) ω := by
    funext ω
    simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]; simp
  rw [hpt, integral_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (integrable_const (g i)).indicator (hms i)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [integral_indicator_const _ (hms i), measureReal_def, hlaw i, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hp i),
    smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

theorem markov_tail {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (F : Ω → ℝ) (hFnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ F ω) (hFint : Integrable F μ) {t c : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (hE : ∫ ω, F ω ∂μ ≤ c) :
    μ {ω | t ≤ F ω} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c / t) := by
  have hMk := mul_meas_ge_le_integral_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hFnn) hFint t
  have hle : μ.real {ω | t ≤ F ω} ≤ c / t := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ht]; linarith
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (measure_ne_top μ {ω | t ≤ F ω})]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hle

theorem frob_sq_U {n k : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hU : U.transpose * U = 1) :
    ∑ i, ∑ a, U i a ^ 2 = k := by
  have h : ∀ a b, ∑ i, U i a * U i b = (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) a b := by
    intro a b
    have := congrFun (congrFun hU a) b
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply] using this
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [sq, h, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
  simp

/-- Cauchy–Schwarz for a bilinear form: (Σ xₐx_b Q_ab)² ≤ ‖x‖⁴ ‖Q‖_F². -/
theorem cs_quad {k : ℕ} (x : Fin k → ℝ) (Q : Fin k → Fin k → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, x a * x b * Q a b) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ a, x a ^ 2) ^ 2 * ∑ a, ∑ b, Q a b ^ 2 := by
  have h := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k × Fin k))
    (fun p => x p.1 * x p.2) (fun p => Q p.1 p.2)

  have e : ∑ a, ∑ b, (x a * x b) ^ 2 = (∑ a, x a ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [sq (∑ a, x a ^ 2), Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring
  rw [e] at h

    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {n k s : ℕ} (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hZ : Z.transpose * Z = 1)
