theorem pos_of_pd (μ : Fin k → ℝ) (h : pd (U * diagonal μ * U.transpose)) (j : Fin k) :
    0 < μ j := by
  have he : U.transpose *ᵥ (U *ᵥ Pi.single j 1) = Pi.single j 1 := by
    rw [mulVec_mulVec, hU1, one_mulVec]
  have hx : U *ᵥ Pi.single j 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, mulVec_zero] at he
    have := congrFun he j
    simp at this
  have := h _ hx
  rw [conj_quad, he] at this
  simpa [Pi.single_apply] using this

end conj

/-! ## Sherman–Morrison, trace form -/

theorem sherman_morrison {k : ℕ} (M P : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (hMP : M * P = 1)
    (hP : P.transpose = P) (v : Fin k → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hden : 1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v)) ≠ 0) :
    (M + t • vecMulVec v v)⁻¹ =
      P - (t / (1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v)))) • vecMulVec (P *ᵥ v) (P *ᵥ v) := by
  apply inv_eq_right_inv
  set q := v ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v) with hq
  set c := t / (1 + t * q) with hc
  have hvP : v ᵥ* P = P *ᵥ v := by rw [← mulVec_transpose, hP]
  have e1 : M * vecMulVec (P *ᵥ v) (P *ᵥ v) = vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [mul_vecMulVec, mulVec_mulVec, hMP, one_mulVec]
  have e2 : vecMulVec v v * P = vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) := by rw [vecMulVec_mul, hvP]
  have e3 : vecMulVec v v * vecMulVec (P *ᵥ v) (P *ᵥ v) = q • vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) := by
    rw [vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, vecMulVec_smul]
  have hcq : t - c - c * t * q = 0 := by
    rw [hc]; field_simp; ring
  rw [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_sub, hMP, Matrix.mul_smul, e1, Matrix.smul_mul,
    e2, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, e3, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  have : (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - c • vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) +
      (t • vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) - (t * c * q) • vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v))
      = 1 + (t - c - c * t * q) • vecMulVec v (P *ᵥ v) := by
    module
  rw [this, hcq, zero_smul, add_zero]

theorem sm_trace {k : ℕ} (M P : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (hMP : M * P = 1)
    (hP : P.transpose = P) (v : Fin k → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hden : 1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v)) ≠ 0) :
    trace (M + t • vecMulVec v v)⁻¹ =
      trace P - t / (1 + t * (v ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v))) * ((P *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v)) := by
  rw [sherman_morrison M P hMP hP v t hden, trace_sub, trace_smul, trace_vecMulVec, smul_eq_mul]


/-! ## Quadratic forms -/

theorem quad_rank1 {k : ℕ} (u x : Fin k → ℝ) : x ⬝ᵥ (vecMulVec u u *ᵥ x) = (u ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := by
  simp only [dotProduct, mulVec, vecMulVec_apply, sq, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring

theorem quad_add {k : ℕ} (M N : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (x : Fin k → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ ((M + N) *ᵥ x) = x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) + x ⬝ᵥ (N *ᵥ x) := by
  rw [add_mulVec, dotProduct_add]

theorem quad_smul {k : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (x : Fin k → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ ((c • M) *ᵥ x) = c * x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) := by
  rw [smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]

theorem quad_one {k : ℕ} (x : Fin k → ℝ) : x ⬝ᵥ ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) *ᵥ x) = ∑ b, x b ^ 2 := by
  rw [one_mulVec]; simp [dotProduct, sq]

theorem quad_sum {n k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (f : Fin n → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (x : Fin k → ℝ) : x ⬝ᵥ ((∑ i ∈ S, f i) *ᵥ x) = ∑ i ∈ S, x ⬝ᵥ (f i *ᵥ x) := by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i S hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, quad_add, ih]

/-- The sparsifier Σᵢ sᵢ vᵢvᵢᵀ. -/
noncomputable def Aof {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ) (s : Fin n → ℝ) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ :=
  ∑ i, s i • vecMulVec (v i) (v i)

theorem Aof_quad {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ) (s : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Fin k → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ (Aof v s *ᵥ x) = ∑ i, s i * (v i ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := by
  unfold Aof
  rw [quad_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [quad_smul, quad_rank1]

theorem Aof_symm {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ) (s : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (Aof v s).transpose = Aof v s := by
  unfold Aof
  rw [transpose_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [transpose_smul, transpose_vecMulVec]

/-! ## The scalar inequality behind the averaging step -/

theorem key_ineq {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (μ : Fin k → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ j, 0 < μ j)
    (hΦ : ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹ < 1) :
    (∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹ - (μ j + 1)⁻¹)) * (1 - ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹) <
      ∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹) ^ 2 - (∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹ - (μ j + 1)⁻¹)) * ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ := by
  set a : Fin k → ℝ := fun j => (μ j)⁻¹ with ha
  set b : Fin k → ℝ := fun j => (μ j + 1)⁻¹ with hb
  have hab : ∀ j, a j - b j = a j * b j := fun j => by
    simp only [ha, hb]; field_simp [(hμ j).ne', (by linarith [hμ j] : μ j + 1 ≠ 0)]; ring
  have ha0 : ∀ j, 0 < a j := fun j => inv_pos.mpr (hμ j)
  have hb0 : ∀ j, 0 < b j := fun j => inv_pos.mpr (by linarith [hμ j])
  have hD : ∑ j, (a j - b j) = ∑ j, a j * b j := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hab j
  have hA : ∑ j, a j = ∑ j, a j * b j + ∑ j, b j := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by linarith [hab j]
  have hA2 : ∑ j, a j ^ 2 = ∑ j, a j * b j + ∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    have h := hab j
    calc a j ^ 2 = a j * (a j - b j) + a j * b j := by ring
      _ = a j * (a j * b j) + a j * b j := by rw [h]
      _ = a j * b j + a j ^ 2 * b j := by ring
  -- Cauchy–Schwarz: (Σ ab)² ≤ (Σ a²b)(Σ b)
  have hcs : (∑ j, a j * b j) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j) * ∑ j, b j := by
    have := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ (fun j => a j * Real.sqrt (b j))
      (fun j => Real.sqrt (b j))
    have e1 : ∀ j, a j * Real.sqrt (b j) * Real.sqrt (b j) = a j * b j := fun j => by
      rw [mul_assoc, Real.mul_self_sqrt (hb0 j).le]
    have e2 : ∀ j, (a j * Real.sqrt (b j)) ^ 2 = a j ^ 2 * b j := fun j => by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hb0 j).le]
    have e3 : ∀ j, Real.sqrt (b j) ^ 2 = b j := fun j => Real.sq_sqrt (hb0 j).le
    simp only [e1, e2, e3] at this
    exact this
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j := by
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, hk⟩⟩
    exact Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => mul_pos (pow_pos (ha0 j) 2) (hb0 j)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hlt : (∑ j, a j * b j) ^ 2 < ∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j := by
    calc (∑ j, a j * b j) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j) * ∑ j, b j := hcs
      _ < (∑ j, a j ^ 2 * b j) * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hΦ hpos
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  show (∑ j, (a j - b j)) * (1 - ∑ j, b j) < ∑ j, a j ^ 2 - (∑ j, (a j - b j)) * ∑ j, a j
  rw [hD, hA2, hA]
  nlinarith [hlt]


/-! ## One barrier step -/

theorem sum_rank1_conj {n k : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ a b : Fin k, ∑ i, v i a * v i b = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (hU1 : U.transpose * U = 1) (j : Fin k) :
    ∑ i, ((U.transpose *ᵥ v i) j) ^ 2 = 1 := by
  have hV : ∑ i, vecMulVec (v i) (v i) = (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) := by
    ext a b
    rw [Matrix.sum_apply]
    simp only [vecMulVec_apply, one_apply]
    exact hv a b
  have hconj : ∀ x : Fin k → ℝ,
      vecMulVec (U.transpose *ᵥ x) (U.transpose *ᵥ x) = U.transpose * vecMulVec x x * U := by
    intro x
    rw [mul_vecMulVec, vecMulVec_mul, ← mulVec_transpose]
  have hsum : ∑ i, vecMulVec (U.transpose *ᵥ v i) (U.transpose *ᵥ v i) = 1 := by
    simp only [hconj]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, hV, Matrix.mul_one, hU1]
  have := congrFun (congrFun hsum j) j
  rw [Matrix.sum_apply] at this
  simpa [vecMulVec_apply, sq] using this

theorem step {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ a b : Fin k, ∑ i, v i a * v i b = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (w : Fin n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (φ0 : ℝ) (hφ0 : φ0 < 1)
    (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (hA : A.transpose = A) (L : ℝ)
    (hpd : pd (A - L • 1)) (hΦ : trace (A - L • 1)⁻¹ ≤ φ0) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t * w i ≤ (∑ j, w j) / (1 - φ0) ∧
      pd (A + t • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) - (L + 1) • 1) ∧
      trace (A + t • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) - (L + 1) • 1)⁻¹ ≤ φ0 := by
  have hsym : (A - L • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)).transpose = A - L • 1 := by
    rw [transpose_sub, transpose_smul, transpose_one, hA]
  obtain ⟨U, β, hU1, hU2, hB⟩ := spectral _ hsym
  have hβ : ∀ j, 0 < β j := pos_of_pd U hU1 β (hB ▸ hpd)
  have hΦeq : trace (A - L • 1)⁻¹ = ∑ j, (β j)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hB, conj_inv U hU1 hU2 β (fun j => (hβ j).ne'), conj_trace U hU1]
  have hβ1 : ∀ j, 1 < β j := by
    intro j
    have h1 : (β j)⁻¹ ≤ ∑ j, (β j)⁻¹ :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => (inv_pos.mpr (hβ i)).le) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have h2 : (β j)⁻¹ < 1 := by linarith
    by_contra h3
    have h4 : 1 ≤ (β j)⁻¹ := (one_le_inv₀ (hβ j)).mpr (not_lt.mp h3)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨μ, hμdef⟩ : ∃ μ : Fin k → ℝ, ∀ j, μ j = β j - 1 := ⟨fun j => β j - 1, fun j => rfl⟩
  have hμ : ∀ j, 0 < μ j := fun j => by rw [hμdef]; linarith [hβ1 j]
  have hβμ : ∀ j, β j = μ j + 1 := fun j => by rw [hμdef]; ring
  have hM : A - (L + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) = U * diagonal μ * U.transpose := by
    have h := conj_sub U hU2 β 1
    rw [one_smul, ← hB] at h
    have hd : (fun j => β j - 1) = μ := funext fun j => (hμdef j).symm
    rw [hd] at h
    rw [← h, add_smul, one_smul, sub_sub]
  have hMpd : pd (A - (L + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)) := by
    rw [hM]; exact pd_of_pos U hU2 μ hμ
  set P : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ := U * diagonal (fun j => (μ j)⁻¹) * U.transpose with hPdef
  have hMP : (A - (L + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)) * P = 1 := by
    rw [hM, hPdef, conj_mul U hU1]
    have : (fun j => μ j * (μ j)⁻¹) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := funext fun j => mul_inv_cancel₀ (hμ j).ne'
    rw [this, diagonal_one, Matrix.mul_one, hU2]
  have hPsym : P.transpose = P := by
    rw [hPdef, transpose_mul, transpose_mul, transpose_transpose, diagonal_transpose,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  clear_value P
  have hq1 : ∀ i, v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) = ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ * ((U.transpose *ᵥ v i) j) ^ 2 := fun i => by
    rw [hPdef, conj_quad]
  have hq2 : ∀ i, (P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) =
      ∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹ * (μ j)⁻¹) * ((U.transpose *ᵥ v i) j) ^ 2 := fun i => by
    have e : (P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) = v i ⬝ᵥ ((P * P) *ᵥ v i) := by
      rw [← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec, ← mulVec_transpose, hPsym, dotProduct_comm]
    rw [e, hPdef, conj_mul U hU1, conj_quad]
  have hvt := sum_rank1_conj v hv U hU1
  have hsum1 : ∑ i, v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) = ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [hq1]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hvt j, mul_one]
  have hsum2 : ∑ i, (P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) = ∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [hq2]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hvt j, mul_one, sq]
  have hΦμ : trace (A - L • 1)⁻¹ = ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hΦeq]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [hβμ]
  have htrP : trace P = ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ := by rw [hPdef, conj_trace U hU1]
  set D := ∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹ - (μ j + 1)⁻¹) with hD
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by
    haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := ⟨⟨0, hk⟩⟩
    refine Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => ?_) Finset.univ_nonempty
    have := (inv_lt_inv₀ (by linarith [hμ j]) (hμ j)).mpr (by linarith : μ j < μ j + 1)
    linarith
  have hΦlt : ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹ < 1 := by rw [← hΦμ]; linarith
  have key := key_ineq hk μ hμ hΦlt
  rw [← hD] at key
  set W := ∑ j, w j with hW
  set c : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => (P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) - D * (v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i)) with hc
  set e : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => D * w i * (1 - φ0) / W with he
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hw i
  have he0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i := fun i => by
    simp only [he]; exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hDpos.le (hw i)) (by linarith)) hW0
  have hsume : ∑ i, e i ≤ D * (1 - φ0) := by
    have : ∑ i, e i = D * (1 - φ0) / W * W := by
      calc ∑ i, e i = ∑ i, D * (1 - φ0) / W * w i :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [he]; ring
        _ = D * (1 - φ0) / W * ∑ i, w i := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
        _ = D * (1 - φ0) / W * W := by rw [hW]
    rw [this]
    by_cases h0 : W = 0
    · rw [h0, mul_zero]; exact mul_nonneg hDpos.le (by linarith)
    · rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ h0]
  have hsumc : ∑ i, c i = ∑ j, ((μ j)⁻¹) ^ 2 - D * ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [hc]; rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hsum1, hsum2]
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ i, (c i - e i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsumc]
    have h1 : D * (1 - φ0) ≤ D * (1 - ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by rw [← hΦμ]; linarith) hDpos.le
    linarith
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, 0 < c i - e i := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have : ∑ i, (c i - e i) ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos fun i _ => h i
    linarith
  have hci : 0 < c i := by linarith [he0 i]
  refine ⟨i, D / c i, div_pos hDpos hci, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- the trace (upper) budget
    by_cases h0 : W = 0
    · have hwi : w i = 0 := le_antisymm
        ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hw j) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans h0.le) (hw i)
      rw [hwi, mul_zero, h0, zero_div]
    · have hWpos : 0 < W := lt_of_le_of_ne hW0 (Ne.symm h0)
      have h1 : D * w i * (1 - φ0) < c i * W := by
        have : e i < c i := by linarith
        simp only [he] at this
        exact (div_lt_iff₀ hWpos).mp this
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hci (by linarith)]
      linarith
  · intro x hx
    rw [show A + (D / c i) • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) - (L + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
        = (A - (L + 1) • 1) + (D / c i) • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) by abel,
      quad_add, quad_smul, quad_rank1]
    have := hMpd x hx
    have : 0 ≤ D / c i * (v i ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (div_pos hDpos hci).le (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  · have hq1n : 0 ≤ v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) := by
      rw [hq1]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr (hμ j)).le (sq_nonneg _)
    have hden : 1 + D / c i * (v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i)) ≠ 0 := by
      have := mul_nonneg (div_pos hDpos hci).le hq1n
      linarith
    rw [show A + (D / c i) • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) - (L + 1) • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
        = (A - (L + 1) • 1) + (D / c i) • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) by abel,
      sm_trace _ P hMP hPsym (v i) _ hden, htrP]
    have hcdef : c i = (P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i) - D * (v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i)) := rfl
    have hdrop : D / c i / (1 + D / c i * (v i ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i))) * ((P *ᵥ v i) ⬝ᵥ (P *ᵥ v i)) = D := by
      field_simp
      rw [hcdef]
      ring
    rw [hdrop]
    have : ∑ j, (μ j)⁻¹ - D = ∑ j, (μ j + 1)⁻¹ := by
      rw [hD, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; ring
    rw [this, ← hΦμ]
    exact hΦ

/-! ## Iterating the step -/

theorem iterate {n k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ a b : Fin k, ∑ i, v i a * v i b = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (w : Fin n → ℝ) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (φ0 : ℝ) (hφ0 : φ0 < 1) (L0 : ℝ)
    (hbpd : pd ((0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - L0 • 1))
    (hbtr : trace ((0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - L0 • 1)⁻¹ ≤ φ0) :
    ∀ τ : ℕ, ∃ s : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i ≠ 0).card ≤ τ ∧
      ∑ i, s i * w i ≤ τ * ((∑ j, w j) / (1 - φ0)) ∧
      pd (Aof v s - (L0 + τ) • 1) ∧ trace (Aof v s - (L0 + τ) • 1)⁻¹ ≤ φ0
  | 0 => by
    have h0 : Aof v (0 : Fin n → ℝ) = 0 := by simp [Aof]
    refine ⟨0, fun i => le_refl _, by simp, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h0]; simpa using hbpd
    · rw [h0]; simpa using hbtr
  | τ + 1 => by
    obtain ⟨s, hs0, hcard, hwt, hpd, htr⟩ := iterate hk v hv w hw φ0 hφ0 L0 hbpd hbtr τ
    obtain ⟨i, t, ht, htw, hpd', htr'⟩ :=
      step hk v hv w hw φ0 hφ0 (Aof v s) (Aof_symm v s) (L0 + τ) hpd htr
    set s' : Fin n → ℝ := fun j => s j + if j = i then t else 0 with hs'
    have hA' : Aof v s' = Aof v s + t • vecMulVec (v i) (v i) := by
      unfold Aof
      simp only [hs', add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_smul, zero_smul, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
        Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    have hL : L0 + ((τ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = L0 + τ + 1 := by push_cast; ring
    refine ⟨s', fun j => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [hs']; split_ifs <;> linarith [hs0 j]
    · have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s' j ≠ 0) ⊆
          insert i (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s j ≠ 0) := by
        intro j hj
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert] at hj ⊢
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · exact Or.inl hji
        · right; simpa [hs', hji] using hj
      calc (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s' j ≠ 0).card
          ≤ (insert i (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s j ≠ 0)).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
        _ ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s j ≠ 0).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le _ _
        _ ≤ τ + 1 := by omega
    · have : ∑ j, s' j * w j = ∑ j, s j * w j + t * w i := by
        simp only [hs', add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
          Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
      rw [this]; push_cast; linarith
    · rw [hA', hL]; exact hpd'
    · rw [hA', hL]; exact htr'

end BSS

open BSS in
theorem woodruff_theorem50 {n k ℓ : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Fin k → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ a b : Fin k, ∑ i, v i a * v i b = if a = b then 1 else 0)
    (a : Fin n → Fin ℓ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (hkn : k < n) (hkr : k < r) (hrn : r ≤ n) :
    ∃ s : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) ∧ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i ≠ 0).card ≤ r ∧
      (∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, (1 - Real.sqrt (k / r)) ^ 2 * ∑ b, x b ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ i, s i * (∑ b, v i b * x b) ^ 2) ∧
      ∑ i, s i * ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
  · subst hk
    refine ⟨0, fun i => le_refl _, by simp, fun x => by simp, ?_⟩
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast (lt_trans hk hkr)
  set φ0 := Real.sqrt (k / r) with hφ0def
  have hφ0 : φ0 < 1 := by
    rw [hφ0def, Real.sqrt_lt' one_pos, one_pow]
    exact (div_lt_one hr0).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hkr)
  have hφ0nn : 0 ≤ φ0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  set c := Real.sqrt (r * k) with hcdef
  have hc0 : 0 < c := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hrc : c = r * φ0 := by
    rw [hcdef, hφ0def, show (r : ℝ) * k = r ^ 2 * (k / r) by field_simp,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hr0.le]
  -- base of the barrier: A = 0, L0 = -c
  have hbase : (0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - (-c) • 1 = c • 1 := by
    rw [zero_sub, neg_smul, neg_neg]
  have hbpd : pd ((0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - (-c) • 1) := by
    rw [hbase]
    intro x hx
    rw [quad_smul, quad_one]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hx
    have : 0 < ∑ b, x b ^ 2 := Finset.sum_pos' (fun b _ => sq_nonneg _)
      ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (pow_ne_zero 2 hj))⟩
    positivity
  have hbtr : trace ((0 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - (-c) • 1)⁻¹ ≤ φ0 := by
    rw [hbase]
    have hinv : (c • (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ))⁻¹ = c⁻¹ • 1 := by
      apply inv_eq_right_inv
      rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, Matrix.one_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc0.ne', one_smul]
    rw [hinv, trace_smul, trace_one, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
    have e : φ0 * c = k := by
      rw [hφ0def, hcdef, ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity),
        show (k : ℝ) / r * (r * k) = k ^ 2 by field_simp, Real.sqrt_sq hk0.le]
    apply le_of_eq
    rw [← e]; field_simp
  set w : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 with hwdef
  have hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i := fun i => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hcard, hwt, hpd, -⟩ := iterate hk v hv w hw φ0 hφ0 (-c) hbpd hbtr r
  have hLr : -c + (r : ℝ) = r * (1 - φ0) := by rw [hrc]; ring
  rw [hLr] at hpd
  have hquad : ∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, r * (1 - φ0) * ∑ b, x b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, s i * (v i ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · subst hx; simp
    · have := hpd x hx
      rw [sub_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, quad_smul, quad_one, Aof_quad] at this
      linarith
  have hf0 : 0 < (1 - φ0) / r := div_pos (by linarith) hr0
  refine ⟨fun i => (1 - φ0) / r * s i, fun i => mul_nonneg hf0.le (hs0 i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : (Finset.univ.filter fun i => (1 - φ0) / r * s i ≠ 0) =
        Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i ≠ 0 := by
      ext i; simp [hf0.ne']
    rw [this]; exact hcard
  · intro x
    have h := hquad x
    have e : ∑ i, (1 - φ0) / r * s i * (∑ b, v i b * x b) ^ 2 =
        (1 - φ0) / r * ∑ i, s i * (v i ⬝ᵥ x) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [dotProduct]; ring
    rw [e]
    calc (1 - φ0) ^ 2 * ∑ b, x b ^ 2 = (1 - φ0) / r * (r * (1 - φ0) * ∑ b, x b ^ 2) := by
          field_simp [show (1 : ℝ) - φ0 ≠ 0 by linarith, hr0.ne']
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hf0.le
  · have e : ∑ i, (1 - φ0) / r * s i * ∑ j, a i j ^ 2 = (1 - φ0) / r * ∑ i, s i * w i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp only [hwdef]; ring
    rw [e]
    calc (1 - φ0) / r * ∑ i, s i * w i ≤ (1 - φ0) / r * (r * ((∑ j, w j) / (1 - φ0))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwt hf0.le
      _ = ∑ j, w j := by field_simp [show (1 : ℝ) - φ0 ≠ 0 by linarith, hr0.ne']


namespace L48

/-- Squared Frobenius norm. -/
def fs {m p : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ a, ∑ b, M a b ^ 2

/-- Frobenius inner product. -/
def ip {m p : ℕ} (X Y : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ a, ∑ b, X a b * Y a b

theorem fs_nonneg {m p : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) : 0 ≤ fs M :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _

theorem frob_eq {m p : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) : frob M = Real.sqrt (fs M) := rfl

theorem fs_transpose {m p : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) : fs M.transpose = fs M := by
  unfold fs
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

theorem frob_transpose {m p : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) : frob M.transpose = frob M := by
  rw [frob_eq, frob_eq, fs_transpose]

theorem fs_sub_comm {m p : ℕ} (X Y : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) : fs (X - Y) = fs (Y - X) := by
  unfold fs
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  simp only [Matrix.sub_apply]; ring

theorem frob_sub_comm {m p : ℕ} (X Y : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    frob (X - Y) = frob (Y - X) := by
  rw [frob_eq, frob_eq, fs_sub_comm]

/-- `fs` of a difference. -/
theorem fs_sub {m p : ℕ} (X Y : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    fs (X - Y) = fs X - 2 * ip X Y + fs Y := by
  unfold fs ip
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  rw [Matrix.sub_apply]; ring

/-- From √a ≤ √b with a, b ≥ 0, get a ≤ b. -/
theorem le_of_sqrt_le' {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (h : Real.sqrt a ≤ Real.sqrt b) :
    a ≤ b :=
  calc a = Real.sqrt a ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt ha).symm
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt b ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) h 2
    _ = b := Real.sq_sqrt hb

theorem sum3_swap {α β γ : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [Fintype γ] (f : α → β → γ → ℝ) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, f a b c = ∑ c, ∑ b, ∑ a, f a b c :=
  calc ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, f a b c = ∑ b, ∑ a, ∑ c, f a b c := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ a, f a b c := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ c, ∑ b, ∑ a, f a b c := Finset.sum_comm

/-- ⟨X, YZ⟩ = ⟨YᵀX, Z⟩ (from our Lemma 45 file). -/
theorem ip_mul {m p q : ℕ} (X : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) ℝ) (Y : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin p) ℝ) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, X a b * (Y * Z) a b = ∑ c, ∑ b, (Y.transpose * X) c b * Z c b := by
  have hL : ∀ a b, X a b * (Y * Z) a b = ∑ c, X a b * Y a c * Z c b := fun a b => by
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => by ring
  have hR : ∀ c b, (Y.transpose * X) c b * Z c b = ∑ a, X a b * Y a c * Z c b := fun c b => by
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]; ring
  simp only [hL, hR]
  exact sum3_swap _

/-- Pythagoras: `UᵀE = 0`, `UᵀU = 1` give ‖E − UT‖² = ‖E‖² + ‖T‖² (from our Lemma 45 file). -/
theorem pythag {n k d : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hU : U.transpose * U = 1)
    (E : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (hUE : U.transpose * E = 0) (T : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin d) ℝ) :
    fs (E - U * T) = fs E + fs T := by
  have h1 := ip_mul E U T
  have h2 := ip_mul (U * T) U T
  rw [hUE] at h1
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hU, Matrix.one_mul] at h2
  simp only [Matrix.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero] at h1
  rw [fs_sub]
  unfold ip fs
  rw [h1]
  have h3 : ∑ i, ∑ j, (U * T) i j ^ 2 = ∑ a, ∑ j, T a j ^ 2 := by
    simp only [sq]; rw [h2]
  rw [h3]; ring

/-- Our Lemma 48 (`cur/proofs/L48.lean`), without its two hypotheses that the proof never uses. -/
theorem lemma48_core {m n k c : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hZ : Z.transpose * Z = 1)
    (E : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (hE : A = A * Z * Z.transpose + E)
    (S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin c) ℝ)
    (W : Matrix (Fin c) (Fin k) ℝ) (hW : Z.transpose * S * W = 1) :
    (∃ X : Matrix (Fin c) (Fin n) ℝ, X.rank ≤ k ∧
      frob (A - A * S * X) ^ 2 ≤ frob E ^ 2 + frob (E * S * W) ^ 2) ∧
    ∀ P Xk : Matrix (Fin c) (Fin n) ℝ,
      (∀ X : Matrix (Fin c) (Fin n) ℝ, frob (A - A * S * P) ≤ frob (A - A * S * X)) →
      Xk.rank ≤ k →
      (∀ X : Matrix (Fin c) (Fin n) ℝ, X.rank ≤ k → frob (A - A * S * Xk) ≤ frob (A - A * S * X)) →
      frob (A - A * S * P) ^ 2 ≤ frob (A - A * S * Xk) ^ 2 ∧
        frob (A - A * S * Xk) ^ 2 ≤ frob E ^ 2 + frob (E * S * W) ^ 2 := by
  have hEZ : E * Z = 0 := by
    have h : E = A - A * Z * Z.transpose := eq_sub_of_add_eq' hE.symm
    rw [h, Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc (A * Z), hZ, Matrix.mul_one, sub_self]
  have hsplit : A - A * S * (W * Z.transpose) = E - E * S * W * Z.transpose := by
    have h1 : A * S * (W * Z.transpose) = A * Z * Z.transpose + E * S * W * Z.transpose := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hE]
      rw [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.add_mul]
      congr 1
      · rw [show A * Z * Z.transpose * S * (W * Z.transpose)
            = A * Z * (Z.transpose * S * W) * Z.transpose by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc], hW,
          Matrix.mul_one]
      · simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    calc A - A * S * (W * Z.transpose)
        = (A * Z * Z.transpose + E) - (A * Z * Z.transpose + E * S * W * Z.transpose) := by
          rw [h1, ← hE]
      _ = E - E * S * W * Z.transpose := by abel
  have hfs : fs (A - A * S * (W * Z.transpose)) = fs E + fs (E * S * W) := by
    rw [hsplit, ← fs_transpose, Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_mul (E * S * W),
      Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    have hZE : Z.transpose * E.transpose = 0 := by
      rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, hEZ, Matrix.transpose_zero]
    rw [pythag Z hZ E.transpose hZE, fs_transpose, fs_transpose]
  have hsq : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ, frob M ^ 2 = fs M := fun M => by
    rw [frob_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (fs_nonneg _)]
  have hsq' : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin k) ℝ, frob M ^ 2 = fs M := fun M => by
    rw [frob_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (fs_nonneg _)]
  have hrk : (W * Z.transpose).rank ≤ k :=
    (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_le_width W)
  have hcand : frob (A - A * S * (W * Z.transpose)) ^ 2 ≤ frob E ^ 2 + frob (E * S * W) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hsq, hsq, hsq', hfs]
  refine ⟨⟨W * Z.transpose, hrk, hcand⟩, fun P Xk hP hXk hbest => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hP Xk) 2
  · exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hbest _ hrk) 2).trans hcand

/-- If GGᵀ ≽ c·I with c > 0, then W = Gᵀ(GGᵀ)⁻¹ is a right inverse of G and ‖yᵀW‖² ≤ ‖y‖²/c. -/
theorem right_inv_bound {k s : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin s) ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hG : ∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, c * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ x ⬝ᵥ ((G * G.transpose) *ᵥ x)) :
    G * (G.transpose * (G * G.transpose)⁻¹) = 1 ∧
      ∀ y : Fin s → ℝ, (y ᵥ* (G.transpose * (G * G.transpose)⁻¹)) ⬝ᵥ
        (y ᵥ* (G.transpose * (G * G.transpose)⁻¹)) ≤ (y ⬝ᵥ y) / c := by
  set N := G * G.transpose with hN
  have hdet : IsUnit N.det := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h0
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hNv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr h0
    have := hG v
    rw [hNv, dotProduct_zero] at this
    have hvv : 0 < v ⬝ᵥ v := by
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hv
      simp only [dotProduct]
      exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _)
        ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, mul_self_pos.mpr hj⟩
    nlinarith
  have hNi : N * N⁻¹ = 1 := mul_nonsing_inv N hdet
  have hNsym : N.transpose = N := by rw [hN, transpose_mul, transpose_transpose]
  have hNisym : (N⁻¹).transpose = N⁻¹ := by rw [transpose_nonsing_inv, hNsym]
  refine ⟨by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hNi], fun y => ?_⟩
  set u := y ᵥ* (G.transpose * N⁻¹) with hu
  -- u = N⁻¹ (G y)
  have hu' : u = N⁻¹ *ᵥ (G *ᵥ y) := by
    rw [hu, ← mulVec_transpose, transpose_mul, transpose_transpose, hNisym, mulVec_mulVec]
  -- Gᵀu = Π y with Π = Gᵀ N⁻¹ G
  set py := G.transpose *ᵥ u with hpy
  have h1 : c * (u ⬝ᵥ u) ≤ py ⬝ᵥ py := by
    have := hG u
    rw [hN, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec, ← mulVec_transpose] at this
    exact this
  -- ‖py‖² = y ⬝ py, because Π is a symmetric projection
  have h2 : py ⬝ᵥ py = y ⬝ᵥ py := by
    have e1 : py ⬝ᵥ py = u ⬝ᵥ (N *ᵥ u) := by
      rw [hpy, hN, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec, ← mulVec_transpose, transpose_transpose]
      exact dotProduct_comm _ _
    have e2 : N *ᵥ u = G *ᵥ y := by rw [hu', mulVec_mulVec, hNi, one_mulVec]
    rw [e1, e2, hpy]
    conv_rhs => rw [dotProduct_mulVec, ← mulVec_transpose, transpose_transpose]
    exact dotProduct_comm _ _
  -- Cauchy–Schwarz: (y ⬝ py)² ≤ (y ⬝ y)(py ⬝ py), so ‖py‖² ≤ ‖y‖²
  have h3 : py ⬝ᵥ py ≤ y ⬝ᵥ y := by
    have hcs : (y ⬝ᵥ py) ^ 2 ≤ (y ⬝ᵥ y) * (py ⬝ᵥ py) := by
      simp only [dotProduct]
      have := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ y py
      simpa [sq] using this
    have hp : 0 ≤ py ⬝ᵥ py := by
      simp only [dotProduct]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
    rw [← h2] at hcs
    rcases hp.eq_or_lt with h | h
    · rw [← h]; simp only [dotProduct]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_self_nonneg _
    · nlinarith
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hc]
  linarith


/-! ## Lemma 55: the deterministic core -/

/-- Rows: ‖YW‖_F² ≤ ‖Y‖_F²/c from the row bound. -/
theorem fs_mul_le {m s k : ℕ} (Y : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin s) ℝ) (W : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin k) ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hrow : ∀ y : Fin s → ℝ, (y ᵥ* W) ⬝ᵥ (y ᵥ* W) ≤ (y ⬝ᵥ y) / c) :
    frob (Y * W) ^ 2 ≤ frob Y ^ 2 / c := by
  unfold frob
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _),
    Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _),
    Finset.sum_div]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
  have h := hrow (Y a)
  simp only [dotProduct, ← sq] at h
  exact h

theorem quad_gram {k s : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin s) ℝ) (x : Fin k → ℝ) :
    x ⬝ᵥ ((G * G.transpose) *ᵥ x) = (x ᵥ* G) ⬝ᵥ (x ᵥ* G) := by
  rw [← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec, mulVec_transpose]

theorem det55 {m n k s ξ : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hks : 4 * k ≤ s) (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin k) ℝ) (hZ : Z.transpose * Z = 1)
    (hZgood : ∀ B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ, B.rank ≤ k →
      frob (A - A * Z * Z.transpose) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / 9) * frob (A - B) ^ 2)
    (P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin s) ℝ)
    (h17 : ∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, (1 - 1 / 2) * ∑ a, x a ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ j, (∑ a, x a * (Z.transpose * P) a j) ^ 2)
    (h49 : ∑ a, ∑ b, ((A - A * Z * Z.transpose) * P) a b ^ 2 ≤
      10 * ∑ a, ∑ b, (A - A * Z * Z.transpose) a b ^ 2)
    (b : Fin s → Fin ξ → ℝ)
    (hemb : ∀ j, (1 - 1 / 2) * ∑ a, ((A - A * Z * Z.transpose) * P) a j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ l, b j l ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ l, b j l ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / 2) * ∑ a, ((A - A * Z * Z.transpose) * P) a j ^ 2) :
    (∃ R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ, ∃ V : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin k) ℝ, V.transpose * V = 1 ∧
        Z.transpose * P = R * V.transpose) ∧
      ∀ (R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (V : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin k) ℝ), V.transpose * V = 1 →
        Z.transpose * P = R * V.transpose →
        (∃ s₁ : Fin s → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ s₁ j) ∧ (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s₁ j ≠ 0).card ≤ 4 * k ∧
          (∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, 1 / 4 * ∑ b, x b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, s₁ j * (∑ b, V j b * x b) ^ 2) ∧
          ∑ j, s₁ j * ∑ l, b j l ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, ∑ l, b j l ^ 2) ∧
        ∀ s₁ : Fin s → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ s₁ j) → (Finset.univ.filter fun j => s₁ j ≠ 0).card ≤ 4 * k →
          (∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, 1 / 4 * ∑ b, x b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, s₁ j * (∑ b, V j b * x b) ^ 2) →
          ∑ j, s₁ j * ∑ l, b j l ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, ∑ l, b j l ^ 2 →
          (∃ X : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin n) ℝ, X.rank ≤ k ∧ ∀ B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ, B.rank ≤ k →
            frob (A - A * P * Matrix.diagonal (fun j => Real.sqrt (s₁ j)) * X) ^ 2 ≤
              2410 / 9 * frob (A - B) ^ 2) ∧
          ∀ P' : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin n) ℝ,
            (∀ X : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin n) ℝ,
              frob (A - A * P * Matrix.diagonal (fun j => Real.sqrt (s₁ j)) * P') ≤
              frob (A - A * P * Matrix.diagonal (fun j => Real.sqrt (s₁ j)) * X)) →
            ∀ B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ, B.rank ≤ k →
              frob (A - A * P * Matrix.diagonal (fun j => Real.sqrt (s₁ j)) * P') ^ 2 ≤
                2410 / 9 * frob (A - B) ^ 2 := by
  set E := A - A * Z * Z.transpose with hEdef
  set M := Z.transpose * P with hM
  have hsumsq : ∀ (w : Fin s → ℝ), ∑ j, w j ^ 2 = w ⬝ᵥ w := fun w => by simp [dotProduct, sq]
  have hsumsqk : ∀ (w : Fin k → ℝ), ∑ j, w j ^ 2 = w ⬝ᵥ w := fun w => by simp [dotProduct, sq]
  -- (32): MMᵀ ≽ ½ I
  have hMM : ∀ x : Fin k → ℝ, 1 / 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ x) ≤ x ⬝ᵥ ((M * M.transpose) *ᵥ x) := by
    intro x
    have h := h17 x
    rw [quad_gram, ← hsumsqk]
    have e : ∑ j, (∑ a, x a * M a j) ^ 2 = (x ᵥ* M) ⬝ᵥ (x ᵥ* M) := by
      simp [dotProduct, vecMul, sq]

/-- Union bound when two of the three events are measurable (Carathéodory for the third). -/
theorem prob_comb {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (G9 G17 G49 T : Set Ω) (hm17 : MeasurableSet G17) (hm49 : MeasurableSet G49)
    (h9 : ENNReal.ofReal (1 - 1 / 100) ≤ μ G9) (h17 : ENNReal.ofReal (1 - 9 / 100) ≤ μ G17)
    (h49 : ENNReal.ofReal 0.9 ≤ μ G49) (hsub : G9 ∩ (G17 ∩ G49) ⊆ T) :
    ENNReal.ofReal 0.8 ≤ μ T := by
  have hG : MeasurableSet (G17 ∩ G49) := hm17.inter hm49
  have hsplit := measure_inter_add_diff (μ := μ) G9 hG
  have hc17 : μ G17ᶜ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (9 / 100) := by
    rw [prob_compl_eq_one_sub hm17]
    calc 1 - μ G17 ≤ 1 - ENNReal.ofReal (1 - 9 / 100) := tsub_le_tsub_left h17 1
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (9 / 100) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_one, ← ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have hc49 : μ G49ᶜ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 10) := by
    rw [prob_compl_eq_one_sub hm49]
    calc 1 - μ G49 ≤ 1 - ENNReal.ofReal 0.9 := tsub_le_tsub_left h49 1
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 10) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_one, ← ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have hdiff : μ (G9 \ (G17 ∩ G49)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (19 / 100) := by
    calc μ (G9 \ (G17 ∩ G49)) ≤ μ (G17ᶜ ∪ G49ᶜ) := measure_mono fun ω hω => by
          simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_inter_iff, not_and_or] at hω
          rcases hω.2 with h | h
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr h
      _ ≤ μ G17ᶜ + μ G49ᶜ := measure_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (9 / 100) + ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 10) := add_le_add hc17 hc49
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (19 / 100) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have h1 : ENNReal.ofReal 0.8 + ENNReal.ofReal (19 / 100) ≤
      μ (G9 ∩ (G17 ∩ G49)) + ENNReal.ofReal (19 / 100) := by
    calc ENNReal.ofReal 0.8 + ENNReal.ofReal (19 / 100) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - 1 / 100) := by
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]; norm_num
      _ ≤ μ G9 := h9
      _ = μ (G9 ∩ (G17 ∩ G49)) + μ (G9 \ (G17 ∩ G49)) := hsplit.symm
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl hdiff
  exact ((ENNReal.add_le_add_iff_right ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mp h1).trans (measure_mono hsub)
